title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.


### **Job Description**


Job Ref ID: JR0085668

**YOUR MISSION**


As the Head of Product Strategy \& Operations for Brands Ads, you are the strategy and scaling engine behind Glovo's fastest\-growing revenue stream. Your core challenge over the next 12\-18 months is to anchor the Go\-to\-Market roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero, launch best\-in\-class ad placements globally, and define the automated tools and infrastructure required to optimize campaigns at scale.

* Product Roadmap Influence: Anchor the GTM roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero Product teams. Identify gaps, prioritize local market needs with Local Heads, and launch 2\+ new ad placements globally.

**Must have:**

* 7\+ years of deep, specialized experience in AdTech, Digital Ads, or a marketplace advertising network.
* Elite stakeholder management skills; capable of aligning Delivery Hero Product, Glovo Product, Data, and Local Heads in a highly matrixed environment.
* Proven ability to define operational tools and scalable processes for campaign optimization, paired with strong financial planning/modeling skills.
* Experience managing hybrid teams (direct and dotted\-line reporting lines) to execute complex, cross\-functional strategic goals.

**Nice to have:**

* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a business owner.

title: Game Design Director - Star Trek Fleet Command
Specialist, Creative Strategy
description:
**About Darkroom**


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Specialist, Creative Strategy to lead day\-to\-day creative execution for Darkroom's social programs — both paid social advertising and organic content \- across a portfolio of client accounts. You're comfortable diving into the feed and the ad account alike, giving tactical, platform\-native feedback on statics, hooks, pacing, captions, and edit structure for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram. You're likely a Creative Strategist, Social Strategist, or Video Editor by trade, with hands\-on experience shipping content that performs, not just looks good.


You'll work on our Performance Creative service — our AI\-powered creative engagement for paid and organic social — helping clients increase the diversity and volume of their creative program (upwards of 50\+ new assets per month) while keeping every piece grounded in what's actually driving hooks, watch time, and conversion.


You'll work daily alongside Designers, Editors, and Creative Strategists to keep the social and paid social creative pipeline moving — briefing assets, giving feedback, and translating client goals and platform data into concepts that ship on time and drive results.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day creative execution for paid social and organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on statics, motion, short\-form video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Copywriting: Own creative copy for US\-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to platform and purpose, threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy
* Own the testing and content calendar cadence — what ships, in what order, against what hypothesis or content pillar
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic winners worth scaling into paid, and with Social Commerce on creator and UGC briefs
* Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
* Present creative and content work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and rationale
* Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g. FLORA, Midjourney, Runway, Claude) to increase the speed and volume of output

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**

* 4\+ years managing or leading creative execution for paid social and/or organic social programs, ideally at an agency
* Hands\-on with short\-form video, statics, and platform\-native content for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram — you can storyboard, cut, and ship, not just direct
* Comfortable jumping into Figma, Premiere, or Photoshop yourself when needed — this isn't a strategy\-only role
* Fluent in both paid and organic metrics (CTR, hook retention, watch time, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) and use them to decide what to make next
* A clear, proactive communicator who gives crisp feedback to designers and editors and can present to clients
* Already using AI tools to speed up and scale creative production
* A portfolio showing paid and/or organic social work with real performance or engagement context

### **Hard Disqualifiers**

* No hands\-on experience shipping paid or organic social creative (design, video, or content)
* No portfolio link or no performance/engagement context
* Strategy\-only with no execution ability
* Not comfortable presenting work to clients

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love . As the largest Ortho clinic chain in Europe, we combine cutting\-edge tech with expert care, revolutionizing invisible orthodontics since 2019\.


With 150\+ clinics across 10 countries and rapid growth, we’re improving lives worldwide.


We are looking for a Head of Design to join our Onsite Team in Barcelona.

  

Why we’re cool:

* Work with an international and multicultural team
* Competitive salary
* Teeth aligner and whitening benefits
* Collaborative work environment and positive culture
* Opportunities to grow within a fast\-paced, innovative company and real start\-up experience with big challenges

* Proven experience leading design for conversion\-driven journeys (funnels, onboarding, booking flows).
* Experience building and scaling design systems in complex product environments.
* Strong UX thinking with ability to simplify regulated or clinically complex domains.
* Hands\-on with Figma and modern design workflows.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
* Fluent English — Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.
* A portfolio that shows shipped PDP/PLP/Checkout improvements tied to clear business metrics.
* Expert in Figma (components, variables, Dev Mode); strong visual/motion craft and responsive design sensibility.
* Proven experience implementing GenAI tools into a professional design pipeline, with a clear understanding of prompt engineering, quality control, and brand governance.
* Familiarity with AI\-shaped UX patterns: conversational search, assistant UI, recommendation modules, and their measurement.
* Comfort collaborating on experiments (A/B vs multi\-armed bandits) with the CRO team; understands trade\-offs between optimization speed and causal certainty.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.2 and SEO fundamentals for structured content and schema on e\-commerce sites.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Experience designing chat or guided\-selling flows



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits** 




  





**💰 Compensation:** 



* Total Annual Package: Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
* Annual salary review every January



  





**🏥 Health \& Protection:** 




 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
 



  





**🌴 Time Off:** 




 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays
 



  





**💼 Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

### **Position at Logitech:**

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.


### **The Team And Role:**

A leader in sustainability, Logitech designs software\-enabled hardware solutions in pursuit of our mission to extend human potential in work and play.


Our Creative \& Design team delivers award\-winning design and creative excellence.


The Associate Creative Director is a strategically minded, hands\-on creative who works closely with the Creative Director to raise the ambition, originality and effectiveness of Logitech’s creative output.


You will help shape how the brand shows up across campaigns, content and experiences, bringing together strong ideas, distinctive art direction and exceptional craft. You will be equally comfortable developing a big idea, shaping a visual world, challenging and refining creative, and getting into the detail to make the work better.


Working across Logitech Personal Workspace (PWS) and with teams across the business, you will help create attention grabbing work and creative experiences that are culturally relevant, strategically grounded and distinctly Logitech.


**Your Contribution:**
----------------------

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.


In this role you will:


* Shape creative ideas: Develop original, strategically grounded ideas that bring Logitech’s brand, products and business ambitions to life. Push beyond the expected to create work that is distinctive, relevant and memorable.
* Raise the creative bar: Work closely with the Creative Director to elevate the quality, ambition and originality of our creative output. Bring a critical eye to ideas and execution, knowing when to challenge, refine or push further.
* Be hands\-on: Concept, art direct and design integrated creative across campaigns, content, social, digital, photography, film and other brand experiences. Remain close to the work from initial idea through to final execution.
* Build compelling creative worlds: Develop strong visual and conceptual systems that give campaigns a distinctive point of view and create consistency across multiple channels and markets.
* Champion the brand: Help evolve and strengthen Logitech’s creative expression, ensuring work feels unmistakably Logitech while remaining fresh, contemporary and culturally relevant.
* Collaboration is key: Partner with writers, designers, strategists, marketers, producers and external creative partners to turn ambitious ideas into exceptional work. Help create an environment where the best idea wins.
* Present and influence: Clearly articulate creative thinking, concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders and cross\-functional partners are what helps Logitech succeed. So build confidence in the work and use feedback to make it stronger.
* Put the consumer first: Develop a strong understanding of consumer mindsets, behaviours and cultural context to create work that is meaningful, useful and engaging.
* Bring craft and detail: Have a deep appreciation for design, typography, photography, film, motion, digital and emerging forms of creative expression. Know that great ideas only become great work through great execution.

-----------------------

For this position we are looking for you to demonstrate:


* 10\+ years of experience with a standout portfolio of original, strategically grounded, big idea driven advertising, brand and engagement work. B2C experience is essential, with B2B experience a huge plus.

* Exceptional conceptual and art direction skills, with the ability to turn strategic challenges into simple, compelling and distinctive creative ideas.
* A high level of craft and a strong understanding of how to take an idea from initial thought through to polished final execution.
* Experience working with and influencing senior creative, marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders, with the ability to clearly articulate creative strategy, narrative and ideas.
* Strong presentation skills and the confidence to champion creative thinking while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.

title: Senior Director Creative Strategy
description:
Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care. COTY is the global leader in fragrance and number three in color cosmetics. COTY’s products are sold in over 150 countries around the world. COTY and its brands are committed to range of social causes as well as seeking to minimize its impact on the environment. For additional information about Coty Inc., please visit www.coty.com.
   

  

**MISSION**
 Reporting to the SVP Brand \& Equity, the role of Creative Strategy Snr Director, Consumer Beauty will be fully responsible for leading creative strategy across the iconic brands within the CB portfolio: across Color cosmetics and Mass scenting.
   

  

 This pivotal role will partner with the creative teams and brand teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – writing innovative creative strategy, cultural levers and conceptual ideas borne of consumer insight.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role, half strategist half creative. The Creative Strategy Snr Director – Consumer Beauty might need to write a headline one day, write a compelling pithy presentation the next, a script the next, and think through what the cultural springboard is for a brand or a campaign. Or take the SVP’s place in a creative review to ensure the work is clear, effective and impactful, and refined until delivery. All while taking pressure off the SVP to free up focus for higher\-level priorities.
   

  

 Coty is a challenger brand; work is intense and entrepreneurial. It is agile and fast. Immediacy and hands on attitude is critical. Autonomy is pivotal.
   

  

 Please note that whilst this position will be based in our Wimbledon Office, we do offer a flexible Omni\-working policy which means that up to 50% of your hours will be based from the office and the remaining 50% of your hours can be remote.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
* Leading Creative strategy across the iconic brands within the Consumer Beauty portfolio.
* A unicorn with the ability to write disruptive creative strategy, borne of consumer insight, and concept ideas with the creatives.
* Critical ability to write in a pithy and provocative way, with fearless clarity.
* Partner with the creative teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – helping generate vital creative thought starters which can be further developed.
* Pivotal ability to help teams (creative and brand) ‘see’ the idea amongst the clutter of creative development; articulating, expanding, and presenting story telling in a way that becomes unmissable and strategically flawless.
* Develop product claims and (both traditional and contemporary) to create something innovative that the world cannot miss!
* Responsible for creative strategy across color cosmetics, personal care, nail and mass scenting/fragrance.
* Social first thinker \- with the ability to brand build in the new Meta led landscape our brands now live in.
* Connected to global culture, knowledgeable.
* GLOBAL \- this is global business. Must be well versed in US beauty, as well as European beauty.
* A realist \- not precious – if it doesn’t work or is too highbrow, move on!
* Hand\-On. Not a floater waiting for other to action.


**What You’ll Bring**
 Knowledge and Experience:
   

  

* 15\+ years experience in an agency/in\-house brand creative strategist.
* Global in outlook
* TikTok and socially savvy.
* Consumer first thinker.
* Ability to co\-create with the SVP Brand \& Equity, the creative teams, third parties and the brand teams within a highly collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of hierarchy with both multifunctional partners and with external stakeholders.
* A ‘roll the sleeves up do\-er’ not a floater. We are an entrepreneurial set of people that think and do, and we do it fast.
* Ability to work autonomously under pressure.
* Agile and adaptable as the business and brand environment changes daily.
* Experienced in the new beauty world \- not the old traditional world.
* A good beauty aesthete \- this person needs judgment and an eye. They will take responsibility for the work being on brand, on strategy and effective (passing IPSOS tests, and driving in market growth)


**REQUIRED SKILLS:**
* Ability to think creatively, highly\-driven and self\-motivated.
* Digitally literate and culturally plugged in.
* Well versed in UK/EU/Global mass consumer beauty universes (color cosmetics and fragrance)
* Ability to work in an international business context.


**CONCLUDING**
 You’ll get to work in a diverse and environment with a team who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way. Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Design Director
description:
**Design Director** 




**Orangery® — Guildford, Surrey** 




**Full\-time · Hybrid · £62,000–£68,000** 




  





**\-\-\-\-** 




  





**We're a six\-person B\-Corp studio in Guildford looking for a Design Director. A senior, hands\-on creative who can take an idea, elevate it, and drive it through to work we're all proud to put our name on.** 




  





 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. The other half is varied: rebrands, strategic design projects and campaigns for clients across technology and B2B.
 



  





 You'll work closely with our Executive Creative Director, and you'll direct our freelance bench of 2D, 3D, animation, film and photography specialists, setting the standard and holding the line on quality. There's real scope to get out on shoots, directing photography and video. We're genuinely collaborative — ideas come from everywhere here, and the best one wins regardless of who had it. Leadership is earned, and it's there to take.
 



  





 Everyone here is senior enough to manage their own work and their own diary, and is trusted to get on with it. No unnecessary layers, no agency politics.
 



  





 We're also early in our AI journey, building it into how we brief, research and produce. If that interests you, it's a good moment to join.
 



  





**The role** 




  




* Leading creative direction across brand and campaign work
* Developing campaign ideas that work across multiple channels — social\-first content through to print and environmental
* Building and evolving brand identities, visual systems, guidelines and campaign toolkits for regional and global rollout
* Directing our freelance bench, including film, video and photography direction and editing
* Quality\-checking work to both creative and technical standards before it leaves the studio
* Presenting and defending work directly to clients
* Bringing creative thinking into pitches and new business alongside the ECD



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* Around 8\+ years in an agency or studio, with time at senior, lead or director level
* A portfolio strong on both concept and craft, showing brand and campaign work — and evidence of consistency across volume, not only one\-off showpieces
* Strong conceptual thinking: you generate original ideas rather than jumping straight to execution, and you can turn a complex brief into a clear creative narrative
* Brand strategy awareness — positioning, audiences, and connecting business objectives to creative solutions
* Fluency in social\-first, platform\-native campaign creative
* An exceptional eye for detail and strong typographic craft
* Confident with print artwork and production
* Experience briefing and directing freelancers — photographers, filmmakers, animators and other specialists
* Experience with high\-profile brands and/or complex campaign rollouts
* Figma as your day\-to\-day, alongside advanced Adobe CS. Motion skills an advantage



  





**A word on sport** 




  





 A meaningful part of this role is racket sports — tennis in particular. We're not just looking for a fan. We're looking for someone who can get properly under the skin of a subculture and make work that people inside it recognise as true. If that's tennis for you, brilliant. If you've done it with running, football, climbing, skate or music, we're just as interested.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





**£62,000–£68,000 depending on experience, plus:** 




  




* Hybrid working — ideally 3 days a week in the Guildford studio, 2 remote
* 9–5\. No evenings, no weekend heroics
* Genuine autonomy — you manage your own diary
* Exposure to a major global sports brand, alongside work in technology and B2B
* Structured personal development and training
* Pension scheme and salary sacrifice EV scheme
* Birthday day off and volunteer days
* Carbon reduction commitments and regular team culture days
* As a B\-Corp studio, we look for people who share our commitment to responsible, thoughtful ways of working.



  





**Apply** 




  






 We value thoughtful, genuine applications that reflect your own experience and perspective. This helps us understand how you think and approach your work, which is more important to us than polished or generic responses.
 




  






 Please send your
 
**CV and a link to your portfolio** 

 to
 
**careers@orangerycreative.com** 




  






 We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we believe this makes our work and our business stronger.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**About Trip**
 TRIP’s mission is to create calm in the everyday chaos for our community, offering next\-generation wellness products to power their lifestyle and nurture mental wellbeing.
   

  

 Co\-founders, husband and wife team Olivia and Daniel discovered plant\-based wellness after a transformative personal experience and decided to launch TRIP in 2019 to bring the most delicious, highest quality functional drinks and supplements to millions of people globally.
   

  

 Now the world’s \#1 Calming Beverage Brand, TRIP’s award\-winning drinks and wellness products are crafted with botanicals and adaptogens to help people relax, unwind and find balance. Since launch, TRIP has rapidly expanded from the UK to across Europe and North America, generating over $100 million in sales. TRIP products are now available in leading supermarkets, natural retailers and online.
   

  

 Our vision is to become the global leader in calming drinks and supplements. Synonymous with calm in the same way Red Bull is with energy. We move fast, think big and are committed to becoming the defining brand for a generation who drinks less but prioritises mental wellbeing more than ever. There has never been a better time to join our incredible team and be part of the movement!
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 This is an opportunity to lead the creative vision for one of the most exciting and fast\-growing beverage brands in the market. TRIP is known for its creative\-first approach and distinctive brand identity, and is rapidly expanding across the US and internationally. We’re looking for a Head of Creative to own and evolve our creative vision while playing a pivotal role in scaling the brand globally.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership**
* Lead and inspire TRIP’s in\-house creative team and external partners, ensuring efficient, high\-quality output across all channels.
* Build and manage the creative team structure, including budgets, resourcing, and freelance support, including US market needs.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, introduce efficiencies, and bring key capabilities in\-house where appropriate.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Marketing, Growth, Sales, and E\-commerce teams to deliver best\-in\-class creative solutions.
* Champion and educate the broader organization on TRIP’s brand, creative assets, and processes to maximise impact.
* Develop deep channel expertise within the team, across UK and US\-focused platforms and retail environments (e.g. Amazon, Meta, retail media, email, web, shopper marketing).
* Balance hands\-on creative contribution with leadership, mentoring and creative direction.
* Build creative processes that improve speed and quality without compromising the work.
* Own creative budgets, resourcing and production planning across UK and US requirements.


**Design Vision**
* Own and evolve TRIP’s global brand identity, ensuring consistency and impact across all touchpoints including packaging, digital, retail, and campaigns.
* Lead the creative direction across US and global markets, adapting where needed to resonate with local audiences and cultural nuances.
* Oversee the development of standout packaging and POS.
* Review and approve all creative output, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and maintaining a high bar for craft and consistency.
* Keep TRIP culturally relevant by staying close to UK and US trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape
* Developing channel expertise in the team to reflect the changing nature of the business goals such as ensuring we know what best in class packaging and POS looks like, as well as Meta assets


**About You**
* At least 10 years proven experience in design \& creative, preferably in\-house with FMCG, Beauty and DTC brands.
* A strong hands\-on creative with an exceptional portfolio demonstrating work you have personally developed and executed, not simply managed or directed.
* Strong experience in the US market, with a deep understanding ofconsumer behavior, retail environments, and media channels.

**About Us**

We are a fast\-paced boutique creative agency managing a diverse portfolio of exciting consumer accounts, including multi\-unit franchise, Quick Service Restaurant (QSR), and Food \& Beverage brands. We believe that great brands aren’t just seen; they are felt.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a versatile, hands\-on **Jr. Associate Creative Director** with a strong background in visual design, social campaign ideation, and digital execution. description:

 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest\-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.

 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.

 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.

 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-forward environment.


*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
 Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 $157,505—$218,000 USD
   

  

**The Engine Edge: Perks \& Compensation**
 We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
   

  

* **Compensation:** 
 Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:** 
 Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.

Reporting to the VP Creative, we are looking for an AI\-Forward ACD \- Art Director who is conceptually\-minded, with a background working across mediums – with a focus on film creative and production. You’ll be hands\-on leading AI\-forward projects for some of the world’s greatest brands – creating visually inspiring ideas that cut through the clutter to set hearts and feeds on fire. You’re an idea generator and are obsessed with bringing high\-level Art Direction craft to every project – whether you’re using the latest AI tools or not. You’ll work hands\-on everyday, but also can lead a team of makers to help bring your vision to life.


This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York office. The salary range for this position is between $130,000\-170,000 USD, annually, and a final offer is dependent on experience.

**Responsibilities**


Creative vision

* Own the Creative Vision on your portfolio of projects – driving creative excellence and consistency across platforms and deliverables.

* Generate creative concepts for multiple brands, and work with a team of designers to bring them to life, visually.
* Be at the forefront of AI tools and bring world\-class Art Direction to the world of AI.
* Confidently present work to clients and respond to feedback with creative solutions.
* Guide a team of designers and editors from concept through to final execution.
* Be highly collaborative \- across teams in the US, UK and Mexico.
* Create film treatments, storyboards, and mood boards that guide the work on AI film production projects.


Leadership \& Team Management

* Regularly share your team’s latest creative work with your VP Creative, working closely for development and sign off.

* Be deft at mixing the latest AI tools with traditional Art Direction and Production techniques for the best possible outputs.
* Build relationships and influence with creatives in the US, UK and Mexico.
* Create groundbreaking visual ideas to promote brand engagement.
* Defend and improve ideas in response to client feedback
* Review work with the Creative Director, Creative VP and ECD, take feedback and actioning their direction across the team.
* Act as a champion for generative innovation by leveraging AI tools to create campaign visuals, generate assets, and iterate on the fly – enabling your team to move faster and stay focused on the big ideas.

* Enthusiasm for the use of AI in Art Direction \- supported by a strong background and commitment to creative craft.

* Deep experience in the entire film production process, from pre\-production through to post production and delivery.
* Expertise and continued awareness across digital, social, AI tools and emerging advertising trends.

**About Upstart**


At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.


As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.


We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. As the **Art Director, Social** at Upstart, you will create culturally relevant, platform\-native art direction across organic social, and contribute to brand campaigns alongside the broader Creative team. You'll combine cultural insight and design craft to help shape how Upstart shows up in culture.  

  

  



**How you’ll make an impact**

description:

 There’s a reason HUNTER is recognized as a PRWeek Best Place To Work and has been named PRovoke “Consumer Agency of the Year” not once, but twice: At HUNTER, we EARN IT — consumer attention, the trust and loyalty of clients, and the dedication of our staff, currently 350\+ strong and counting.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Creative Director is a proven creative leader who consistently develops disruptive, culture\-shaping ideas that cut through and drive earned\-worthy moments for clients. Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self\-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands\-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. As an emerging leader, you mentor and elevate your team while demonstrating the creative maturity and strategic thinking that positions you as the next generation of creative leadership at HUNTER.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership \& Idea Development**
* Lead and own creative work across assigned accounts, consistently and independently generating a high volume of original, disruptive ideas grounded in strategy and on brief
* Develop compelling creative concepts that align with HUNTER client objectives and measurable KPIs; demonstrate strong self\-editing skills to shape ideas into award\-worthy, culture\-disrupting campaigns

* Lead creative concepting, brainstorms, and strategy sessions with energy and conviction, fostering bold thinking and pushing boundaries within strategic intent

* Demonstrate strong conceptual writing skills paired with strategic thinking; ability to articulate ideas with precision and clarity

* Model creative leadership through clear direction, decisive creative judgment, strong taste, and empowerment of individual contributors
* Foster a collaborative team culture where bold ideas are encouraged, feedback is constructive and respectful, and exceptional work is celebrated
* Conduct project\-based performance feedback and contribute to formal performance review processes; support career development and growth
* Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
* Identify growth opportunities with existing clients; support account expansion through strong creative work and strategic thinking


**New Business \& Agency Growth**

* Bring thoughtful, fresh, and strategic ideas to new business opportunities; demonstrate the energy and enthusiasm that wins pitches
* Contribute to agency marketing and thought leadership by sharing strong work and participating in industry conversations


**Budgeting and Finance**
* Track team members hours/rates and OOP costs against budget and work with the ECD to manage billability and useability across the team
* Establish a clear line of communication with account teams, ECD and COO with respect to scoping and pricing models for all projects
* Work with account/HR/Finance team on all vendor agreements, ensuring competitive bids are met and costs are appropriate for the size and scale of the project
* Manage all vendor contracts, and insurance (both freelance and production vendor)


**Qualifications**
* 6\-10\+ years of creative leadership, with proven success leading multidisciplinary teams in integrated marketing, brand experiences, or communications
* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual strength, visual storytelling, and integrated campaign execution
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute innovative campaigns that drive engagement and measurable results
* Record of winning new business and expanding existing client relationships


**Leadership \& People Skills**
* Ability to mentor, coach, and develop creative talent; model strong leadership through clear direction, constructive feedback, and empowerment
* Proven experience managing and inspiring cross\-functional teams across design, content strategy, production, and account management
* Strong communication and presentation skills; confidence when presenting to clients, stakeholders, and executive leadership
* Sharp collaboration and active listening skills, with the ability to align teams and stakeholders around shared vision


**Strategic \& Operational Mindset**
* Strong strategic thinking: ability to dissect briefs, uncover insights, and translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions
* Hands\-on expertise overseeing multiple complex projects at various stages while maintaining high\-level strategic oversight
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and freelance partnerships; commitment to executing projects efficiently and profitably
* Comfort working in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environments
* A good understanding of working with vendors, materials costs, freelance costs, printing and pricing and the ability to reach agreements that are fair and/or favorable to the agency


**Cultural \& Technical Awareness**
* Cultural curiosity and awareness; ability to create ideas that resonate with diverse audiences and communities
* Knowledge of design, production, emerging technologies, and their application to earned, marketing and experiential work
* Strong understanding of social media and digital integration; ability to amplify activations through strategic content and storytelling
* Genuine interest in AI, automation, and emerging tools; eagerness to explore and implement technologies that strengthen creative output

 In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, the Company believes the target range of base compensation for this role is $150,000 \- $175,000\.  At HUNTER, we work hard and play hard, and while we have all the benefits you’d expect —competitive health and dental insurance plans, a 401K company match and generous PTO — we also provide:

description:
**About The Role**
 We’re hiring a Design Director to lead Product Design across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences. You’ll shape how millions of members interact with their money every day—from the experiences they rely on most often to the ones that help them build toward what’s next.
   

  

 This role calls for a leader who pairs exceptional visual craft with strong product thinking. You’ll set a high bar for how our products look, feel, and work; build a clear design vision across a connected portfolio; and lead a talented team of designers in turning complex financial experiences into products that feel simple, intuitive, and distinctly Chime. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, and Brand to make that vision real.
   

  

 The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $242,000 and up to $335,000\. Full\-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
   

  

 In this role, you can expect to
   

  

* Set the design vision and quality bar across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences, creating products that feel cohesive, intuitive, and unmistakably Chime.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, helping them strengthen their craft, expand their impact, and do the best work of their careers.
* Bring a strong point of view on visual and interaction design, using your craft expertise to push the work from good to exceptional while empowering designers to own the solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and translate ambitious ideas into compelling member experiences.
* Think across individual features and journeys to create a connected product experience, balancing immediate member needs with a longer\-term design vision.
* Use research, customer insights, data, and experimentation to understand what matters to our members and guide design decisions.
* Champion design excellence across Chime, contributing to the evolution of our product language, design systems, critique culture, and broader design practice.


 To thrive in this role, you have
   

  

* Experience leading and developing high\-performing product design teams responsible for complex, consumer\-facing digital products.
* A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates exceptional visual and interaction design craft, alongside the ability to translate that standard into the work of a broader team.
* A track record of creating and delivering compelling design visions across multiple products, journeys, or interconnected experiences.
* Deep product design expertise and the judgment to move comfortably between high\-level strategy and the details that make an experience exceptional.
* Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to influence product strategy and deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes.
* Experience building strong design teams through coaching, feedback, critique, and talent development.
* The ability to communicate a clear design point of view, bring people along with your thinking, and create clarity in complex or ambiguous spaces.


**A Little About Us**
 At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank\*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user\-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
   

  

 We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out\-hustle and out\-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
   

  

 We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
   

  

 We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
   

  

 Because if we don't—who will?
