Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.
* Prepare the people slides for our board meetings.

**Culture, communication \& engagement**

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.
* Lead HR and internal communication projects (internal newsletters, AI trainings, Learning \& Development, etc.).
* Organise and host our annual offsite for the Eterniti and Emerald Stay team.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
description:
**About Platform Engineering**
------------------------------


Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through **PlatformCon**, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision\-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.


Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, a growing YouTube channel, and **Weave Intelligence**, our research arm: the analyst practice behind the State of Platform Engineering report, market guides on the platform engineering reference architecture, and a growing set of data products on how the agentic enterprise is actually being built.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Head of Research \& Editorial** to lead Weave Intelligence and own what we say about the industry.


This is the role that owns Platform Engineering's intellectual agenda. Everything we publish across every channel starts with a thesis about where platform engineering, internal developer platforms and agentic software development are going. Today that thesis lives in the heads of our founders. You will make it a practice: a research agenda, an editorial calendar, a standard for what counts as evidence, and a team that turns it into reports, guides, articles, courses and video that the market reads first.


You'll be a named analyst, not a manager of analysts. You will publish under your own byline, take briefings from vendors, sit on our analyst desk at PlatformCon and at KubeCon, re:Invent and Google Cloud Next, and represent Weave in the press. We want you to become one of the voices the industry associates with platform engineering.


You'll also lead the content team that already exists and works: a content operations lead who runs the engine and manages our designers, a narratives and quality lead who holds the bar on every piece, and a video producer who is building our channel. The production engine already exists. Your job is to decide where it points, raise the intellectual and editorial bar, and spend meaningful time doing the research and writing yourself

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the house thesis on platform engineering, PE\+\+ and the agentic enterprise, and keep it ahead of the market.
* Run a quarterly theme calendar that every report, article, webinar, course and video hangs off, and make sure content, events and sales are telling the same story.
* Set the split between net\-new thought leadership backed by our own data and rapid\-response analysis of what the market is discussing, and decide which topics deserve which.
* Lead the Weave Intelligence analyst practice: research agenda, methodology standards, editorial ownership of the State of Platform Engineering and State of AI \& Platform Engineering reports, market guides, and the vendor briefings program.
* Apply and defend our firewall: sponsors buy distribution and association, never conclusions; methodology is published before results; sponsored and syndicated work is always labeled.
* Publish regularly under your own name, and take the analyst chair at our events and at the industry majors we attend.
* Take vendor and enterprise briefings, and turn them into a structured view of the vendor landscape that feeds our reference architecture and our research.
* Lead and develop the content team: a content PM, a narratives and QA lead, a video producer, and through them our brand designers.
* Build relationships with other media houses, analyst firms and independent voices for co\-published research, syndication and joint formats.
* Work with our founders on their public positioning, so that the strongest ideas in the company reach the stage and the page.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 6\+ years in roles where your job was to understand a technology market and say something about it that held up: industry analyst, editor or lead writer at a technical publication, content or product marketing lead who shaped a category, or developer advocacy lead with a strategic remit.
* Real depth in platform engineering, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or the adoption of AI in software development. You can hold your own with a staff engineer and a CTO in the same conversation.
* A body of published work under your own name, and a view on where the industry is going that you can defend with evidence.
* Narrative judgment: you know the difference between a topic and a thesis, and between something that is true and something that is worth saying now.
* Editorial rigor. You have run methodology, sourcing and fact\-checking on work where being wrong had consequences.
* Experience leading a small team of writers, researchers or producers, and making them better rather than louder.
* Comfort in public: on stage, on camera, in a briefing room with a vendor's leadership team.
* Operating discipline: calendars, standards and a cadence that ships.
* Exceptional written and spoken English
* Willingness to travel a few times per year for events and offsites.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience inside an analyst firm, or on the receiving end of one as a vendor.
* A track record of building something recognized as a source: a report people cite, a newsletter people forward, a format people copy.
* Familiarity with survey design and quantitative research methods.
* Existing relationships across the cloud native and developer tooling ecosystem.
* Hands\-on engineering or platform background earlier in your career.
* A practical view on where AI helps and hurts research and editorial work.
* Experience working in a startup or scale\-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

**Why join us?**
----------------


Most analyst jobs ask you to describe a market someone else built. This one asks you to shape one. Platform engineering is a discipline that our community defined, and the agentic enterprise is being defined right now. You'd be doing that work with direct access to the people building the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, a community of hundreds of thousands who already trust us, and a team that can turn an idea into a report, a course, a stage talk and a video in weeks.


There is no legacy research franchise to protect and no house style to inherit. If you want a role where your judgment about what matters becomes what the industry reads, this is that role.

* Trabajarás en un proyecto de alto crecimiento construyendo algo realmente ambicioso.

title: Head of Revenue Operations & Systems
description:
**About Platform Engineering**
------------------------------


Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision\-makers every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, a growing YouTube channel, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a Head of Revenue Operations \& Systems to own operations end to end: our growth\-ops and CRM data layer, the tool stack, event \& ticketing infrastructure, and performance\-marketing data, the systems and processes that let the rest of the company scale. Today, growth ops and internal tooling run on a mix of point\-to\-point integrations and manual fixes that have carried us this far but won't carry us through the next stage. We are already improving parts of this, you will be picking up that momentum and driving it the rest of the way, not starting from a blank slate.


This is a management role from day one. Two people already work in ops, one on revenue ops and one on tooling and custom software, and they will report to you from the start. You will be hands\-on yourself too: building pipelines and workflows directly, not just directing others to. You will join the Platform Engineering Masters leadership team, reporting to Luca, Managing Director of Platform Engineering Masters, alongside peers like the head of revenue and the head of growth.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Replace the current patchwork of Zapier point\-to\-point integrations with a proper operational data layer, so that fixing one connection doesn't mean detective work across a dozen fragile Zaps.
* Own enrichment, deduplication, and lead scoring in our CRM (HubSpot), currently unowned and blocking the marketing team from running effective campaigns.
* Give non\-technical team members self\-service access to their own data and segments, instead of routing every query through engineering.
* Connect ad spend to actual outcomes: get click and conversion data from our ad managers (LinkedIn, Google, Meta) flowing into HubSpot so campaign performance can be measured and fed back into targeting.
* Own our tool stack: build and maintain a registry of every tool in use (technical owner, business owner), lead the retirement of Airtable, and run tool\-selection decisions as a cross\-functional process, not a unilateral ops call.
* Stabilize ticketing and webinar operations ahead of high\-volume periods, our two biggest scale risks right now.
* Manage and grow the ops team: one person on revenue ops and one on tooling and custom software report to you from day one, and you will assess where further hiring is needed.
* Run operations reporting to a predictable calendar, feeding into the company's quarterly budgeting process.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hands\-on engineering skills: you design and build data pipelines and workflows yourself, in SQL and code, not just through no\-code tools or by directing someone else to.
* Experience building performance marketing / ad\-tech systems: conversion tracking, click\-ID matching (LinkedIn, Google, Meta), attribution pipelines, and getting that data to actually land in a CRM correctly.
* Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot or equivalent) at a technical level: custom objects, workflows, API integrations, not just day\-to\-day admin use.
* Solid data modeling and architecture skills: comfortable designing a schema in Postgres/Supabase and deciding what belongs in a warehouse versus in the CRM itself.
* A track record of making tooling decisions that account for the whole team's needs, not just what's easiest to build.
* People management experience. You will be managing two people from your first week.
* Comfortable picking up a system that's already partway improved and driving it forward, rather than needing a blank slate to start from.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with no\-code/low\-code automation tools (n8n, Zapier), and knowing when to replace them with something more robust.
* Familiarity with ad platform APIs (LinkedIn Marketing API, Google Ads API, Meta Conversions API) and server\-side tracking approaches (e.g. Conversions API vs. pixel\-only).

**Why join us?**
----------------


This is a role to take an operations function that's already moving in the right direction and drive it the rest of the way, not a maintenance job, and not a blank\-slate build either. You would be walking into a company that knows exactly what's broken and is ready to invest in fixing it properly, with a small team already in place, direct access to leadership, and the mandate to build the operations function the company needs for its next stage of growth.

title: Strategy Manager
description:
**MGID** is a global advertising technology company and pioneer in native advertising, operating a programmatic platform that connects advertisers and publishers across 200\+ countries. The company runs a real\-time bidding (OpenRTB) business model with AI\-powered targeting and content recommendation widgets, serving hundreds of millions of users monthly.  

  

MGID is seeking a **Strategy Manager** to help define and execute the company’s multi\-year strategic direction, with a strong focus on shifting from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led mindset, evaluating strategic product and investment opportunities, and cascading strategy into prioritized, cross\-functional initiatives.


This role sits within a fast\-moving, data\-driven ad\-tech environment and reports to the COO.

 **Role Purpose**


The Strategy Manager will act as a key strategic partner to the COO and leadership team, responsible for shaping MGID’s medium\- to long\-term strategy, evaluating strategic options for products and markets, and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into concrete, prioritized projects with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

 **Who You Are:**

* 10\+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, or related roles within international tech scale\-ups or high\-growth environments; ad\-tech or programmatic advertising experience is a strong plus.
* Proven track record in a top\-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Big Four strategy practices) or equivalent strategic role in a tech company.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and presenting successful strategic cases with visible internal impact, such as new market entry, product portfolio optimization, or major investment decisions.
* Strong financial modeling skills, including practical experience with valuation methods such as DCF, NPV, and IRR, and the ability to build and maintain investment models in Excel.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, commercial, data/BI, and operations leaders in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior audiences and drive alignment across geographies.
* Self\-starter mindset: ready to operate as an individual contributor who can both design strategy and execute hands\-on.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Corporate \& Product Strategy**

* Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.
* Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.
* Support the shift from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led company by embedding customer\-centric frameworks into strategic planning, prioritization, and roadmap decisions.

**Investment \& Business Evaluation**

* Lead evaluations of stand\-alone investment opportunities, including new products, markets, partnerships, and M\&A, and prepare robust business cases with clear financial impact assessments.
* Own and evolve company evaluation models, including DCF, NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis, and ensure consistent application across strategic and investment decisions.
* Support participation in accelerators and corporate venture initiatives to identify and select startup investments that drive business growth and strategic synergy.

**Strategy Execution \& Prioritization**

* Cascade corporate strategy into granular projects and initiatives, working closely with the CPO, CRO, and BI Director on prioritization, resourcing, and sequencing.
* Define KPIs and performance frameworks to track strategy implementation and outcomes, and establish governance and reporting routines for strategic workstreams.
* Monitor progress, adapt plans in response to changing market conditions, and recommend corrective actions to keep strategic initiatives on track.

**Strategic Analysis \& Advisory**

* Conduct market, competitor, and customer analysis to inform strategic choices and identify opportunities and risks.
* Facilitate scenario planning and stress testing to assess strategic resilience under different market and regulatory conditions.
* Present strategic recommendations and status updates to senior leadership, influencing decision\-making with clear, evidence\-based insights.


At **MGID**, we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for AdTech. Our culture is built on openness, transparency, and a shared drive for excellence. We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people\-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the future of digital advertising!

description:

This role is ideal for someone with hands\-on Hybrid Casual experience who can move quickly in a high\-uncertainty environment, make data\-driven decisions, and confidently decide when to iterate – and when to stop.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Data Modeling & Visualization
description:

Our Data team


Join a dynamic Tech, Data \& Product team of 50 professionals with diverse expertise. You’ll report to the Head of Data and work closely with our Tech, Product, and business teams.


The Data Team is a key driver of innovation at Lengow. From enabling access to insights for employees to creating custom data products for clients, our mission is to transform raw data into business impact. We’re expanding our scope and shaping the future of data at Lengow.


What the Data team does

* Empower business decisions with relevant insights and accessible data tools.
* Guide product development through data\-driven features, metrics, and insights.
* Manage and optimize custom data products for clients.
* Enhance our data stack and tools for scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Cultivate a data\-first culture by translating business needs into actionable insights.


Your mission


We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer — Data Modeling \& Visualization to strengthen the Data Team’s semantic modeling, metrics, and dashboarding capabilities.


With access to vast data — thousands of catalogs, millions of products, and billions of entries scraped from e\-commerce websites — you’ll help transform complex data into reliable models, clear metrics, and useful dashboards for internal and customer\-facing data products.


This role owns the Data Team’s semantic and visualization layer: business\-facing data models, metric definitions, dashboards, validation rules, and documentation. You will work closely with the Product Manager, who owns Product\-side framing, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and business acceptance. Your role is to translate Product and business needs into reliable models, clear KPIs, useful dashboards, and maintainable data products.


This is a senior technical role at the intersection of analytics engineering, data modeling, and data visualization. It is not a Product Manager role or a pure Data Engineering role. It is also not focused on ad hoc reporting: requests should be turned into reusable, maintainable data assets whenever they create recurring value.


Your key responsibilities:

* Own the semantic and visualization layer of Lengow’s internal and customer\-facing data products.
* Define and document KPIs, dimensions, facts, grains, filters, assumptions, and business rules.
* Design reusable analytical models and semantic layers across dashboards and data products.
* Build and improve dashboards in Looker Studio that are clear, useful, performant, and decision\-oriented.
* Transform Product and business requirements into modeled datasets, dashboard specifications, validation rules, and documentation.
* Write advanced SQL transformations and contribute to dbt workflows.
* Collaborate with Senior Data Engineers on upstream data quality, data contracts, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Challenge unclear metric definitions, incomplete acceptance criteria, misleading visualizations, and one\-off requests that should become reusable data products.
* Communicate assumptions, limitations, edge cases, feasibility, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Recruitment Process* Pre\-interview: Chat with Alexandre, Head of People (30').
* Team interview: Meet Sebastien (VP Data) and team members (60').
* Final interview: Present a technical case to Sebastien and Olivier (Chief Product and Technology Officer) (60').

  

**Requirements**  

We’re looking for a senior data professional who combines technical rigor, strong data modeling skills, visualization expertise, and business understanding.


You should be able to understand a business question, challenge vague definitions, design the right analytical model, and deliver a dashboard or data product that can be trusted over time.


Here’s what you bring to the table:

* Experience: 5\+ years in analytics engineering, data visualization engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or a similar data role.
* Data modeling: strong understanding of facts, dimensions, grains, aggregations, metric definitions, semantic consistency, and business rules.
* Data visualization: proven ability to design dashboards that are not only visually clear, but useful for real decisions.
* Engineering fluency: advanced SQL, strong analytical rigor, and good understanding of data quality, lineage, testing, and transformation workflows.

**The role**

You’ll lead four Senior Product Managers, each owning their own squad. You’ll help them make better decisions, challenge their plans, connect the dots across squads, and make sure we’re collectively focused on the problems that matter most.


You’ll act as the VP Product’s key counterpart on the core business, with significant autonomy and responsibility for its product direction.


You’ll also work closely with the senior leadership team alongside the VP Product, giving you strong exposure to company\-level decisions and priorities.

**What floats your boat**

* **Strategy \& Execution**  

You turn strategy into clear priorities and align teams when priorities conflict.
* **Product Organization**  

You improve how the Product team operates, structuring key processes and cross\-team initiatives without adding unnecessary complexity.
* **Business \& Judgment**  

You understand the business, challenge senior stakeholders, and make sound decisions with imperfect information.
* **Team Development**  

You challenge and coach experienced PMs, helping them grow in scope and impact.

* You are fluent in English.
* You have significant Product experience in a mature product organization.
* You have managed experienced PMs / Senior PMs across multiple squads.
* You’re comfortable working directly with senior leadership on business and product decisions.
* You combine strategic thinking with a hands\-on, business\-oriented approach.


**The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values with our VP product and CPTO.

* 8 to 10 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20\-minute walk from the sea;
* Team\-building activities.
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 3 days per month spent in Paris — around 6 to 9 trips per year.
* Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast\-growing company.

**Contract: Permanent position**

**Start date: ASAP**

**A competitive salary starting from €100K.**

**Ready to join?**


If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R\-259586 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
“It is critical that we build and maintain our rich tradition of clinical expertise in support of developing life\-changing medicines for patients.” –Jose Baselga


The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. As part of a competitively selected cohort of Scholars, you will join an accelerated development track within Oncology R\&D. With individualized mentorship, there is opportunity to learn from a diverse group of experts across the drug development continuum, playing a pivotal role in channelling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives. Selected Scholars will join the current cohort of Baselga Cancer Research Scholars, building a vibrant community of drug developers. We are currently recruiting for the 2027 class with an aim to start the position in summer\-autumn 2027\.


**About AstraZeneca Oncology Research \& Development**


Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. We’re pioneering innovative research across six scientific platforms: Tumor drivers and resistance; Immuno\-oncology, DNA damage response, Antibody drug conjugates, Epigenetics and Cell therapies.


Our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. It’s our big vision that unites and inspires us. With multiple indications and high\-quality molecules at all stages of our innovative pipeline, we keep pushing forward. Focusing on cutting\-edge science with the latest technology to achieve breakthroughs. AZ is a place built on courage, curiosity and collaboration – we make bold decisions driven by patient outcomes.


**What you’ll do**


The 2027 AZ Baselga Cancer Research Scholars cohort will join AstraZeneca at a time of tremendous growth and acceleration in the oncology biologics portfolio. Working in a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment you will experience increasing levels of responsibility, following a structured learning plan in the following domains:


1\) **Clinical Study Assignment:** You will join a clinical study team and build experience as a medical leader in clinical development which could be in Early Clinical Development, Late Clinical Development, or one year in each. You will participate in weekly clinical and scientific meetings related to your clinical study, complete AstraZeneca training programs and participate in internal and external scientific meetings. You will work in a cross functional environment, contributing to and supporting Department/Clinical initiatives to improve the quality and content of all clinical programs as well as the cross functional/organization processes designed to effectively deliver our R\&D portfolio.


Specific duties and major responsibilities for the longitudinal medical project may include any of the following:


* Serving as medical director with primary responsibility for patient safety and conduct of assigned trials as well as overall data interpretation and safety surveillance
* Establishing and approving scientific methods for design and implementation of applicable clinical protocols, data collection systems, and final reports
* Assisting in design of clinical development plans and overall strategy for compounds, therapeutic classes of compounds or indications in light of developments in the area of clinical and pharmaceutical oncology
* Collaborating with pre\-clinical and translational sciences, and senior management in assessing requirements for emerging products
* Participating in the selection and management activities of CROs
* Supervising project team members in planning, conducting and evaluating clinical trials
* Planning and managing investigator meetings, advisory boards and other scientific committees

2\) **Rotational program:** During the course of your program, you will be involved in 3\-6 month long rotations across various groups to gain a better understanding of the cross\-functional departments. This could include:


* Patient safety
* Clinical operations
* Regulatory affairs
* Biostatistics
* Medical affairs
* Translational medicine or precision medicine

3\) **Longitudinal Research Project:** You will have opportunity to lead an innovative research project of your choosing for the duration of the 2\-year program, which may be an area of special interest to you and AstraZeneca, or alternatively focus on one or more of the rotational functions. You will be able to harness rich internal datasets and expertise, aiming to deliver a research project at the end of the Program which will be presented to key internal stakeholders, at a key scientific meeting and published in a peer\-reviewed journal.


**Essential for the role:**


MD or equivalent required; ideally board certified (or eligible) preferred in Oncology or Haematology/Oncology

* Medical specialty and sub\-specialty training and Board Certification

* Genuinely curious, you like figuring out a better way to do something rather than just doing it the way you've always done it.

* 1\-2 years of experience in training coordination, HR, learning operations, or a related role.
* Strong writing skills, with a portfolio or writing sample that shows range.

title: Director, Investor Development Team, London
description:
**Requisition ID:** 50633
  
**Business Unit:** Fitch Ratings
  
**Category:** Business Development \& Sales
  
  

**Location:**  

Barcelona, ES
  
  

**Date Posted:** Sep 14, 2026
  
  

Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Director based out of our London office.
  
  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  

About the Team
  
  

Based in London and reporting to the EMEA head of Investor development, this role is part of the Global Investor Development team, in the Fitch Ratings’ Business \& Relationship Management (BRM) organization.
  
Fitch’s Investor Development team aims at positioning Fitch Ratings as the agency of choice with investors in both established and new markets and sectors. Through a wide range of outreach activities and campaigns, it promotes the agency’s research, thought leadership, ratings and capabilities among key market participants and educates on criteria, rating assumptions and case studies.
  
Ultimately the goal of the team is to embed Fitch ratings and support analytics in investor workflows, by driving deeper engagement, providing timely and actionable service levels, offering improved products, and removing barriers to adoption and usage.
  
It also acts as the voice of the investor community within Fitch Ratings, providing critical feedback on rating performance, criteria, analytical interactions and content.
  
The team offers a high\-visibility role with direct interaction with large institutional investors and industry groups and a collaborative team environment with exposure to dynamic, fast\-paced industry trends.
  
  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**  

**You will be responsible for:**  

Building and maintaining relationships with corporate and project finance investors.
  
Strengthening Fitch’s brand presence and embedding Fitch ratings into investor workflows, helping to shift market perceptions that may favor incumbent rating agencies and supporting broader acceptance of Fitch ratings across asset classes.
  
Developing outreach strategies for buy\-side, sell\-side analysts, investor associations, and industry groups.
  
Managing, deepening, and expanding Fitch’s relationships with fixed income investment professionals across a portfolio of key institutional investors.
  
Organizing meetings with analysts, presenting Fitch’s capabilities, educating investors on criteria and rating assumptions, and demonstrating use cases for ratings.
  
Leading broader outreach and visibility initiatives (conferences, roadshows, webinars, roundtables, focused groups, content distribution, thought leadership publications, surveys) in partnership with BRM, Marketing, and Events teams.
  
Developing partnerships with sell\-side research, investor associations and industry groups leveraging Fitch’s content and thought leadership.
  
Designing and driving a program of virtual and in\-person events and campaigns to increase transparency of credit views and rating assumptions and showcase rating capabilities and broader thought leadership, in collaboration with BRM which drives origination priorities and the Marketing team which executes on events and campaigns.
  
Preparing and delivering external messaging that highlights the factors differentiating Fitch and its published ratings and research from competitors.
  
Identifying and helping to address remaining barriers to Fitch’s adoption in domestic capital markets, including investment guidelines, indices, and market platforms.
  
Serving as the primary point of contact for analytical groups on content ideation, market feedback, and investor data analysis, while proactively recommending topics for research and data products based on investor feedback.
  
Gathering and communicating insights on domestic capital markets, financial regulation, and policy developments that influence the use of CRA content and services.
  
Identifying and promoting business opportunities for Fitch Solutions and Fitch Learning.
  
  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**  

6\-8 years sell\-side or buy\-side experience in international fixed income capital market is required to perform this role successfully
  
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long\-term relationships
  
Excellent written communication skills and ability to create strategic messaging
  
Highly motivated and self\-driven with organisational and time\-management skills
  
Degree educated or equivalent work experience
  
  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**  

Existing contacts and relationships with large European investors is beneficial
  
Genuine proficiency in Salesforce and SharePoint is a plus.
  
Strong interpersonal skills is what makes the difference.
  
  

**Why Choose Fitch:**  

**Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
  
**A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated training, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
  
**Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals
  
**Promoting Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
  
**Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
  
**Inclusive Work Environment:** A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
  
**Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community
  
  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day, supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself from them before beginning work.

title: Program Manager
description:
**About Darkroom**
------------------


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**
------------------


This is a dedicated role on a single account, helping a key client bring a brand new product to market, with Darkroom owning all media channels. You are the operational owner of that engagement: the person accountable for the program running on time, in scope, and against every commitment, with no slips in timeline.


That makes this different from a typical agency PM job. You are not coordinating a portfolio. You are going deep on one enterprise client, holding the operating rhythm, and creating accountability within the layers of Darkroom.


You will report to the Director of Growth Strategy on the Hark engagement, with a dotted line to the Managing Director, Paid Media. You will work daily with Paid Social and Paid Search Specialists, Analytics, Creative, and the client's own program leads.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Service level accountability. You track our contracted SLAs, produce the reporting that evidences adherence, and escalate early when something is trending toward a miss. When the client asks whether we hit our commitments, the answer comes from you and it is already documented.
* The Shared Model. You maintain Darkroom's side of the jointly held media plan, forecast, and ramp model, keep it reconciled against actuals, and manage the cadence with the client's team so both sides are always working off the same numbers.
* Scope and budget control. You own hours tracking, scope\-versus\-delivered reconciliation, and ensuring we stay within scope.
* The operating rhythm. Standups, client status calls, internal syncs, QBR prep. Decisions, action items, and blockers documented and visible to both sides.
* Cross\-functional handoffs. Briefs, assets, performance reporting, and campaign builds moving between Media, Creative, and Analytics on schedule, with dependencies mapped.
* Resourcing and capacity. Working with the Director of Growth Strategy and team leads to keep staffing matched to the work, and surfacing capacity risk before it shows up as a slipped deadline.
* Risk escalation. You are the point of escalation for cross\-team dependencies and you keep stakeholders aligned without routing every conversation through leadership.

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**
--------------------------------------------

* You have 3\-5\+ years of project or program management experience, ideally at a media, marketing, creative, or digital agency
* You're conversant in paid media workflows and terminology: campaign builds, flight dates, creative rotations, reporting cadences, even if you've never bought media yourself
* You build the tracker before someone asks for it, and you notice when a timeline is about to slip before anyone else does
* You're a clear, proactive communicator, comfortable managing up, across, and with clients when needed
* You are a Notion guru. Notion is Darkroom’s spine, and one needs to be fluent in Notion. This means designing and maintaining relational databases, building filtered views, and maintaining SOPs.
* You're comfortable working across Slack, Toggl, and Google Sheets\-based trackers as your daily toolkit
* You can juggle multiple accounts and shifting priorities without dropping details
* You hold a high bar for your own output and expect the same from the people you coordinate with

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
--------------------------------------


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Assistant Director - Product Manager
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.


If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


**Skills and Competencies**

* 5\-8 years of product management experience, including independently leading an application programming interface (API), data platform, or technically complex product from discovery through launch and post\-launch improvement
* Strong knowledge of entity resolution, entity matching, reference data management, data ingestion pipelines, and extract, transform, load or extract, load, transform workflows
* Technical fluency in search and data architecture, including OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, data normalization, embedding models, vector databases, indexing, chunking, and retrieval strategies
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex engineering and user needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, roadmaps, and measurable priorities
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating engineering, data, design, customer success, quality control, strategy, enterprise clients, and integration partners
* Proficiency with agile delivery tools and practices, product metrics, structured user research, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Demonstrated understanding of Generative AI technologies and their application within product development environments
* Familiarity with large\-scale batch processing, search relevance, machine\-learning ranking, generative artificial intelligence, or financial and risk data platforms is preferred

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree required. A master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field is preferred

**Responsibilities**


Own and advance a scalable entity matching platform that connects ingestion, search relevance, matching accuracy, and customer integrations.

* Independently manage the product lifecycle for Moody’s Global Match, from discovery and requirements definition through release, partner integration, and post\-launch iteration, operating with moderate guidance
* Own and maintain the product roadmap, translating broader product strategy into prioritized work based on user value, business impact, technical effort, dependencies, and risk
* Write clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, capability summaries, integration guides, and scope documentation for technical and non\-technical audience
* Define and monitor measures of product and pipeline performance, including match accuracy, ingestion latency, application programming interface throughput, hit rate, data quality, and user adoption, and use insights to guide prioritization
* Lead agile delivery ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand\-ups, and retrospectives, to support alignment, delivery discipline, and predictable execution
* Identify user and partner needs through structured stakeholder engagement, moderated interviews, usability testing, and solution validation
* Serve as the product point of contact for integration partners and cross\-functional teams, converting requirements into actionable product work and communicating progress, trade\-offs, risks, and blockers clearly
* Own the roadmap for the data ingestion lifecycle, including source connectors, data processing workflows, storage, indexing, data recency, completeness, and quality controls that support accurate entity matching
* Partner with engineering to evaluate data normalization, chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval, and search relevance approaches, and translate architectural trade\-offs into product decisions
* Collaborate with data quality and quality\-control teams to manage content backlogs, establish ingestion guardrails, preserve data integrity, and improve downstream matching and large language model\-ready outputs
* Improve workflows and operating practices that reduce delivery friction, strengthen collaboration, and increase the team’s ability to deliver measurable product improvements

**About the team**


Our Data \& Information Technology team develops and supports data products and technology capabilities that help customers and internal teams access, align, and use Moody’s information effectively. The team brings together product management, engineering, data, design, customer success, strategy, and quality expertise to improve entity resolution, strengthen data ingestion and search capabilities, and enable reliable integrations. By joining the team, you will help shape a scalable matching platform used across enterprise data and analytics workflows.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Project Director
description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Director in the field of clinical trials who's engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial



As our company continues to grow, we are seeking a Project Director. This position is offered fully remote from the UK, Spain, Poland, Hungary, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia.



The Project Director represents continued advancement upon the project management career track. Responsibilities are defined below and are dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Project Director is assigned but are generally associated with global or large studies or a program of studies. Commonly, the Project Director may be called upon to serve as Portfolio Manager of a suite of studies for a significant client. The Project Director is a critical position that may be called upon to support the Senior Leadership in ensuring continuous process improvement to support strategic company objectives in project execution.


**Esential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**


* Serve as primary point\-of\-contact liaison with client to provide outstanding customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
* Oversee and manages all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials, ensuring consistency across assigned portfolios
* Provide direction to project managers assigned to their trials including project establishment, planning, initiation, procurement, execution and closing
* Manage the study budget, ensuring project remains within scope and that any out of scope activities are identified early and handled as appropriate. Drive any needed change orders to completion and execution with minimal support. Ensure functional areas are fully aware of the study scope and are managing the scope for their functional areas accordingly
* Manage the financial health of assigned studies, including oversight of the project profitability, billable project hours, and compliance with on time, accurate billing and forecasting to support business objectives
* Develop or oversee the development of, robust and comprehensive project plans, including timelines and proactive risk management and mitigation, to guide all parameters of trial execution with consistency and quality. Able to implement strategic planning, risk management and change management with the ability to implement these independently
* Ensure Quality management for assigned projects, including eTMF Inspection readiness, implementation of quality notification incident forms and / or corrective and preventative action plans to address any quality findings
* Establish tracking metrics to monitor trial and team progress towards project goals
* Prepare project status updates for clients and senior management, including reporting on key performance indicators, offering solutions and opportunities as they arise. May be required to attend additional Senior management meetings, to offer further insight and presentations on assigned studies
* Lead both internal and client meetings and set expectations for the project team**,** driving the program or study level strategies forwards with the project team
* Oversee the cross\-functional project team, ensuring efficient management and execution of trials
* Communicate effectively with both sponsor and Precision management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues
* Ability to conduct formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including colleagues, investigative staff, and clients including Bid Defences with a high level of proficiency
* Ensure study specific training is implemented in collaboration with functional areas and ensure study specific training compliance for the duration of the project
* Support business development and marketing activities as appropriate, including travel to Bid Defense meetings as required. As Project Director, proactively drive the Bid defense preparation activities
* Perform other duties as assigned by management
* Remain compliant with organisational training, time\-reporting and any other administrative duties as required
* Mentor associate project managers, project managers or Senior project managers as required
* Participate in the departmental updates, such as the development and updates of company SOPs as needed
* Provides on\-going feedback for functional team members including annual performance reviews
* Identify any performance problem at a project level and ensure an operational corrective action is undertaken (training etc.)
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays


**The ideal candidate will have the following Qualifications/Experience:**


**Minimum Required:**


* North America: Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field. Advanced degree preferred
* EU: Degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field. Advanced degree preferred


**Other Required:**


* Minimum of 8 years of clinical research or proven competencies for this position. A minimum of 5 years direct project management experience
* Highly proficient with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Microsoft Project, eTMF, EDC and CTMS
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor
* Experience managing highly complex and global studies or a portfolio of studies


**Competencies:**


* Demonstrates mastery knowledge of ICH\-GCP, relevant Precision SOPs, as well as the ability to implement such items
* Excellent knowledge of project management techniques and tools
* Highly experienced at working in a cross\-functional project management environment
* Strong understanding of cross\-functional management
* Strong understanding of project planning, risk management and change management with an awareness of appropriate escalation
* High level of integrity and must inspire and demand the highest standards from a professional and ethical perspective
* Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a study team. Motivates other members of the project team to meet timelines and project goals
* Ability to create an environment where study team members have a sense of ownership that will lead to increases in productivity and efficiency
* Results oriented, accountable, motivated and flexible
* Demonstrated excellence in time management, negotiation, critical thinking, decision making, analytical and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated excellence in presentation, verbal and written communications skills
* Expert understanding of project management software
* Highly experienced in pharmaceutical and/or device research required
* Demonstrated expertise in strategic planning, risk management and change management with the ability to implement independently
* Highly developed customer orientation
* Highly developed influence, negotiation and conflict management skills
* Exhibits high self\-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
* Focuses on continuous improvement, including the ability to make proactive assessments on how to make study processes more efficient and study teams more effective


Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry\-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.



We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development.



We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground\-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.



Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.



Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.



If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

title: Senior Direct-Response Video Editor, DTC Performance Ads
description:
**About Us**


HarZa is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health, and we are now launching and scaling new portfolio brands. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to over 150 people across 15\+ countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do. Paid media is our growth engine, and creative volume is what makes it scale.

**The Role**


You will be the editing engine of a performance pod: a small team built around a creative strategist, a media buyer, and a copywriter, shipping direct\-response ads for claims\-led health and wellness brands. This is not a brand content role and not an organic social role. Every asset you cut exists to convert on paid traffic, and your work is measured by how it performs, not only by how it looks.


The creative challenge is specific: our products solve problems (chronic pain, mobility, wellbeing) whose results are not visually obvious. Your edits build belief through mechanism explanation, testimonials, UGC structures, advertorials, and VSL\-style long form, always with awareness that we operate in a compliance\-sensitive category. You will produce both short\-form ads (15 to 60 seconds) and long\-form direct\-response formats (2 to 6 minutes), and a large part of your week is iterating winners: new hooks, new openings, cutdowns, and format variations of ads that are already scaling.


This is a high\-volume seat and we say so openly. The target output is at least one long\-form ad of around 5 minutes plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos per working day, which comes to roughly 15 to 20 delivered assets per week including iterations. If that rhythm sounds extreme, this is not the right role. If it sounds like the environment you already work in, we should talk.

**What You Will Own**


Direct\-response editing at volume. Editing short\-form and long\-form paid ads from strategist scripts and briefs, shipping platform\-native formats for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, and sustaining the daily delivery target of one long\-form plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos without sacrificing the craft details that drive performance: hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.


Winner iteration and creative testing. Producing hook variations, cutdowns, re\-orders, and format swaps of winning ads as a first\-class deliverable. Feeding the testing loop the pod runs every week and turning performance feedback into the next round of edits quickly.


Claims\-led storytelling. Building belief for outcomes the viewer cannot see: visualizing mechanisms, structuring testimonial and UGC narratives, editing advertorial and VSL long form that holds attention for minutes, and handling claims with compliance awareness.


Pod collaboration and documentation. Working async\-first inside the pod with your strategist and media buyer, keeping Asana as the single source of truth for briefs, versions, and delivery status, and turning feedback into revised cuts without friction or ego.

 **Requirements**  

Proven experience editing paid direct\-response ads for DTC or ecommerce brands, where your videos ran on real media budgets and you saw the numbers. Fluency in both short\-form ad formats and long\-form DR (VSLs, advertorials, 2\+ minute belief\-building videos). A demonstrated high\-volume rhythm: you have sustained daily ad output in a testing environment, not one polished piece per week. Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) and a track record of letting data change your edits. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or other claims\-sensitive verticals is a strong plus. Full professional proficiency with a modern editing stack, reliable remote setup, and the self\-management to thrive in an async\-first, output\-measured company.

 **Benefits**  

A fully remote position at a high\-growth DTC operator launching new brands. Real ownership inside a performance pod where your work directly drives scale. Paid time off, wellness stipend, company\-funded computer allowance after tenure milestone, monthly bonus structure, birthday gift card, and in\-country meetup allowance. A culture that rewards output, speed, and mastery of craft.
