* Maintain a small number of processes, with a high/flawless execution standard across all geographies.
* Ensure consistency and internal communication across our three markets (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, and the United States) with three different languages in use.
* Define and roll out the method for communicating complex organizational decisions.

**Partnering with the Leadership Team**


This is the most valuable part of the role and the one that takes the longest to develop. It will unfold in the following phases:

* **Phase 1:** Contribute, together with the CEO, to designing the Leadership Team's performance evaluation framework, as a specific application of the company's general evaluation system.
* **Phase 2:** Develop the Leadership Team's evaluation cycles, in collaboration with the CEO, with increasing autonomy as the cycles mature.
* **Phase 3:** Act as People Business Partner to the Leadership Team, responsible for providing data\-driven assessments on the performance and continuity of its members.

##### **What We are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of work experience building or leading people systems, teams, or processes from scratch.
* 4\+ years of experience leading people or project teams with real business accountability (P\&L, budget, or quota). A background in HR is strongly preferred, but not required.
* Experience operating in multi\-country environments, with teams and stakeholders across different geographies and time zones.
* The following will be positively valued:


	+ Experience in top\-tier strategy consulting, followed by an operational stage.
	+ Prior experience in international organizations or in expanding markets, particularly the United States.
	+ Experience in compensation, leveling, or performance evaluation systems, ideally across several countries.

**Skills**

* Analytical rigor and a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Ability to dive into detail, hold a high execution standard, and connect teams to the company's vision.
* Ability to operate under pressure, at a fast pace of growth, and in an environment of ambiguity and quick decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills at all levels of the organization.
* Interest and passion for developing high\-performing teams, leadership, and corporate culture to achieve ambitious goals.
* An interest in the education sector and genuine motivation and commitment to the project will be positively valued.
* Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Catalan is a plus.

##### **What can you expect from us?**


Our culture and values defines who we are and how we work. We believe that how we do things matters just as much as what we do. We know this isn’t the right place for everyone —and that’s okay. Here’s what you can expect when joining our team:

* **We aim high:** We set ambitious goals and work to high standards. We’re driven by the conviction that improving education is a game changer —and we’re here to take it on with determination and passion. Here, you’ll be able to grow as much as you want!
* **We are owners:** From day one, you’ll take real responsibility and have real impact. We make thoughtful decisions, take initiative, and turn ideas into action —you’ll feel trusted to lead projects, make decisions, and watch your ideas come to life.
* **We move fast:** We work in a dynamic, ever\-evolving environment where speed and adaptability make the difference. Things move fast —and so do we. You’ll feel the pace, the energy, and the thrill of learning and acting quickly to make things happen.
* **We are eager to learn:** Our team is made up of curious, motivated people who challenge themselves —and each other— to grow. We value those who approach every challenge as a learning opportunity and bring a positive, solution\-oriented mindset, because here, every day is a chance to learn something new and share it with others.
* **We are humble:** We’re guided by feedback and collaboration. We listen actively, learn from one another, and value ideas for their impact —not for who they come from. You’ll find teammates who boost you up, challenge you kindly, and celebrate wins as a team.
* **We enjoy the ride:** Our impact depends on the people who make it possible. We’re an international, passionate team that thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment where intensity and purpose go hand in hand. We believe that a strong culture of trust, flexibility, and care is what makes our impact sustainable. We take care of our people so they can take care of our mission —offering flexible working hours, time off during the Christmas break, and flexible compensation options. And of course, we make space to reconnect and recharge through team\-building days that bring us closer and remind us why we do what we do.


If you think you are that person we are looking for **we would love to meet you!**

title: Economic Research & Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst
description:
Economic Research \& Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst
Country: Spain
**IT STARTS HERE**

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a **global, high\-impact brand** into a **technology\-driven organization** , and our people are at the heart of this journey. **Together** , we are driving a **customer\-centric transformation** that values bold **thinking, innovation** , and the **courage to challenge** what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. **It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference** .


Our mission is to contribute to help more **people and businesses prosper** . We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


**The Economic Research Area** is institutionally responsible for preparing and coordinating all macroeconomic forecasts for Santander Bank for the Group’s main forums and Committees. It also conducts macroeconomic and macro\-financial analysis of the Group’s key countries and business units, while advising Senior Management on the economic scenarios relevant to strategic decision\-making


Within the department, the Latin America area coordinates the macroeconomic analysis of the countries where Santander has a presence in the region and integrates local perspectives into a coherent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook. It also participates in the design and preparation of the macroeconomic scenarios used in planning processes and stress\-testing exercises, in close collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas.


**THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE**

**The Economic Research Area** is looking for a **Head of Economic Analysis for Latin America** based out of **Madrid** .


We are looking for a senior or semi\-senior macroeconomist with coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgment and an independent, well\-founded economic view, capable of integrating perspectives from different countries and contributing to the development of the regional view of Latin America and its connection to the Group’s global economic outlook. The candidate should combine strong hard skills (economic analysis, proficiency in econometric software and, preferably, programming) with sound soft skills (teamwork, negotiation and public speaking).


We’re **shaping the way we work** through innovation, cutting\-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


* Coordinate the macroeconomic analysis of Latin America, integrating the perspectives of local economic teams into a coherent and consistent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook.
* Develop and update an independent, well\-founded economic view of Latin America, identifying the region’s main trends, risks and opportunities.
* Participate in the design, preparation and monitoring of the macroeconomic scenarios used in the Group’s planning, budgeting and stress\-testing processes, in collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and contributing independent judgment to the definition and challenge of the scenarios.
* Analyze economic, financial and political developments in the region’s main countries, assessing their implications for Santander.
* Ensure the consistency and quality of the economic forecasts, scenarios and narratives developed for the different Latin American countries, challenging their assumptions when necessary.
* Act as a coordination point between the region’s Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas, facilitating the integration of the regional and global views.
* Prepare reports, presentations and briefings to support the head of the area in interactions with senior management and corporate committees, as well as the planning and risk areas, translating complex economic issues into clear and relevant messages.
* Contribute to cross\-functional projects related to planning, risk management and macroeconomic analysis, providing the Latin American economic perspective.
* Drive continuous improvement in the methodologies, tools and processes used for economic analysis and scenario development.
* Promote the responsible and efficient use of artificial intelligence, automation and data analysis tools to enhance productivity and the quality of analytical work.
* Contribute to the development of other team members through knowledge transfer, guidance and review of their work.
* Represent Banco Santander at various forums and events on Latin America.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re **enabling teams to go beyond** by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


**Professional Experience**

* Solid experience in macroeconomic analysis, economic forecasting, scenario design and coordination, or macro\-financial risk assessment. (Required)
* Experience in preparing, challenging and defending macroeconomic forecasts and economic scenarios. (Required)
* Experience coordinating projects or work involving multiple stakeholders, teams and geographies. (Required)
* Experience preferably gained in economic research departments, financial institutions, central banks, international organizations, research centers or universities. (Required)
* Knowledge of Latin American economies and the main risks and trends affecting the region. (Preferred)

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Economics or related disciplines. (Required)
* Postgraduate education, Master’s degree or PhD in Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Statistics or related fields. (Preferred)

**Languages**

* High level of spoken and written Spanish and English. (Required)
* Knowledge of Portuguese. (Preferred)

**Hard Skills**

* Strong knowledge of macroeconomics, international economics and emerging markets. (Required)
* Strong knowledge of econometrics and quantitative methods applied to forecasting, modeling and macroeconomic analysis. (Required)
* Experience in applied economic analysis, forecasting and scenario development. (Required)
* Proficiency in programming and data analysis tools such as Python, R, Matlab or Stata. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with generative artificial intelligence and automation tools applied to economic analysis and information processing. (Preferred)

**Soft Skills**

* Analytical ability and judgment to develop evidence\-based conclusions.
* Ability to synthesize information and communicate complex economic messages to different types of audiences.
* Global perspective and ability to integrate analyses from different countries into a coherent regional narrative.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in international and multidisciplinary environments.
* Ability to coordinate and manage stakeholders, with a results\-oriented approach, initiative and appropriate prioritization.
* Intellectual curiosity and interest in methodological innovation and new technologies applied to economic analysis.
* Rigorous and responsible approach to identifying and communicating macroeconomic risks.

title: Head of General Counsel
description:
**Europcar Mobility Group**

At **Europcar Mobility Group** , our purpose is to help to change the way you move. We are guided by our core values: *We are happy to help* , *We embrace change* , *We take responsibility* , *We act with respect* and *We move as one* . Our culture is built on valuing the contribution and diversity of our team where every individual is treated with dignity and respect. Acting with respect is at the heart of everything we do, and we are fully committed to creating a workplace where differences are celebrated and everyone feels empowered to contribute their unique perspectives.


**Job Description**

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Legal Strategy \& Business Partnership**

* Act as the primary trusted legal adviser to Iberian senior management and all operational departments including Finance, Operations, Fleet, Customer Service, HR, and Commercial.
* Provide proactive, risk\-calibrated legal guidance that supports business objectives while protecting the Company's interests.
* Anticipate legal risks arising from business operations, market developments, and regulatory changes; recommend and implement preventive legal frameworks.
* Support senior management in strategic decisions including business development, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
Align Iberian legal strategy with Group\-level directives while adapting to the specific legal environment of Spain and Portugal.  
* 

  

**2\. Compliance, Data Protection \& Consumer Law**

* Design, implement, and maintain a robust compliance programme for the Iberian perimeter, aligned with Group Compliance standards and applicable Spanish and Portuguese legislation.
* Manage all matters relating to GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, acting as Local DPO or coordinating with the Group DPO; handle data subject rights requests, supervisory authority interactions (AEPD / CNPD), data processing agreements, and GDPR\-related internal procedures.
* Manage consumer protection compliance across both brands, including coordination with consumer associations, OMIC, and relevant regulatory bodies in Spain and Portugal.
* Ensure compliance with sector\-specific regulations governing vehicle rental, including concession terms at airports and railway stations, ITV obligations, insurance requirements, and fleet\-related regulatory frameworks.
* Oversee the Ethics and Compliance function locally, including management of the Canal Ético (whistleblowing channel) in accordance with Group policy and Ley 2/2023\.
Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in Spain and Portugal relevant to the Group's activities; assess impact and advise accordingly.  
* 

  

**3\. Litigation \& Dispute Resolution**

* Manage all civil, criminal, administrative, and regulatory proceedings involving Europcar and Goldcar entities in the Iberian perimeter, including coordination with external law firms.
* Supervise the preparation of legal submissions and pleadings; maintain oversight of litigation strategy, timelines, and exposure assessments.
* Manage pre\-litigation disputes, including consumer complaints, insurance claims, and counterparty demands, in coordination with relevant operational areas.
Maintain an up\-to\-date litigation register; provide regular reporting on exposure, provisions, and case status to the CFO and Group General Counsel.  
* 

  

**4\. Commercial Contracts \& Public Procurement**

* Provide legal advice on all material contracts including fleet acquisition and financing agreements, concession contracts with airport operators (AENA, ANA, private operators) and railway station operators (Adif, IP), commercial agreements with travel agencies, brokers and corporates, supplier and technology contracts, and insurance policies.
* Lead or support legal aspects of tender processes and public procurement, including preparation, review, and submission of bids for airport and railway station concessions in Spain and Portugal, for both Europcar and Goldcar brands.
* Review and advise on the Company's standard terms and conditions (B2C and B2B), ensuring alignment with consumer protection legislation and sector\-specific regulations.
Advise on negotiations with counterparties; coordinate contract management with internal stakeholders to ensure legal review and sign\-off on significant commitments.  
* 

  

**5\. Corporate Governance \& Secretariat**

* Manage corporate housekeeping for Iberian legal entities, including board minutes, shareholder resolutions, powers of attorney, notarial acts, and registry filings in Spain and Portugal.
* Act as or support the Company Secretary function for relevant Iberian entities.
Ensure proper maintenance of corporate records and statutory registers; liaise with notaries, the Registro Mercantil, and public registries as required.  
* 

  

**6\. Team Leadership \& External Counsel Management**

* Lead, develop, and support one Legal Specialist Iberia, ensuring effective coverage of day\-to\-day legal needs and appropriate prioritisation of workload.
* Select, instruct, and manage external law firms for specialist matters (litigation, employment, regulatory, real estate, etc.), ensuring quality, cost\-efficiency, and alignment with legal strategy.
* Foster legal awareness across the business; deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders on relevant legal topics.
Specific focus on expertise and experience in the management of external law firms in Portugal  
* 

  

**7\. Group Interface \& International Coordination**

* Serve as the primary legal contact between the Iberian business and the Group General Counsel's office; ensure timely reporting and escalation of material legal matters.
* Implement Group legal policies and guidelines within the Iberian perimeter, including in the areas of data protection, competition law, anti\-corruption, and contract standards.
* Cooperate with legal counterparts in other Group jurisdictions on cross\-border matters and shared projects.
Support the adaptation of Group\-level legal frameworks and governance standards into Iberian operations as corporate integration progresses.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED PROFILE**

**Academic Qualifications**

* Law degree required.
* Master's degree in Business Law, EU Law, or an MBA — strongly preferred.
* Bar admission (Colegio de Abogados) — required.
Additional qualifications in Data Protection (CIPP/E, CIPM or equivalent) or Compliance (ICA, CAMS or equivalent) — valued.  
* 

  

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 10\-15 years of legal experience, combining private practice (leading law firm) and/or in\-house roles in a complex, multi\-jurisdictional business environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following: commercial contracts and public procurement / concessions; GDPR and consumer law; regulatory compliance and ethics; corporate governance; dispute resolution and litigation management; fleet, mobility, logistics, or transport\-sector legal work.
* Track record of managing external counsel, controlling legal spend, and reporting to senior management on legal risk.
* Prior experience as a Head of Legal or equivalent senior in\-house role in an international company — highly valued.
* Experience in the vehicle rental, mobility, travel, hospitality, or regulated consumer services sectors — a strong plus.
Familiarity with public tender processes and airport or railway concession frameworks in Spain and/or Portugal — a strong plus.  
* 

  

**Technical \& Legal Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese commercial, corporate, and contract law.
* Strong command of GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, including current AEPD / CNPD enforcement practice.
* Solid understanding of consumer protection law in Spain and Portugal, including sector\-specific regulations applicable to vehicle rental.
* Working knowledge of Spanish public procurement law (Ley 9/2017 LCSP) and concession frameworks applicable to transport infrastructure.
* Familiarity with criminal compliance frameworks (Art. 31bis Codigo Penal) and whistleblowing legislation (Ley 2/2023\).
Proficiency with legal databases (Westlaw, Aranzadi, etc.) and standard legal management tools.  
* 

  

**Languages**

* Spanish — native or full professional proficiency (C2\).
* English — full professional proficiency (C1 minimum); primary language for Group\-level communication and documentation.
Portuguese — professional working proficiency strongly valued, given direct responsibility for Portuguese operations.  
* 

  

**Competencies \& Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen; provides pragmatic, business\-oriented advice beyond purely technical legal analysis.
* High degree of autonomy and personal accountability; able to lead the legal function with limited resources and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; credible with senior management, Group functions, and external parties.
* Strong leadership and people management skills; committed to developing the team and building legal awareness across the organisation.
* Resilient, solutions\-focused, and comfortable operating in an environment of organisational change and complexity.
* Highest standards of professional ethics, integrity, and confidentiality.
Ability to identify, quantify, and communicate legal and regulatory risk clearly to non\-legal audiences, including C\-level stakeholders and Group governance bodies.  
* 

  

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.


**Europcar Mobility Group** is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe. *“We help to change the way you move”* is what we stand for and brings us together.


We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on\-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250\.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.


Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® \- a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® \- a frontrunner at providing low\-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox\-Rent\-A\-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.


Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.


More info at: www.europcar\-mobility\-group.com

title: Specialist, Practice Marketing – Industry
description:

title: Head, Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation [Open to Tier 0, 1 & 2 applicants]
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.  



**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting\-edge global perspectives and advocacy.


The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi\-stakeholder fora including public\-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, and engages in UN inter\-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS works closely with UNDP’s Crisis Bureau (CB) to support emergency and crisis response. BPPS ensures that issues of risk are fully integrated into UNDP’s development programmes. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results\-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 positions prosperity for all as one of four strategic objectives, alongside effective governance, crisis resilience and a healthy planet. The Strategic Plan frames UNDP’s contribution around integrated development solutions that support countries to advance human development in a fast\-changing world, powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Within this framework, prosperity is understood as more than income growth. It is linked to expanded opportunities, decent jobs and livelihoods, access to productive assets, human capital, social protection, essential services, protection from shocks, and the removal of structural barriers that prevent people from participating fully in economic and social life.


Within BPPS, the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub advances UNDP’s integrated prosperity agenda by supporting countries to move from poverty to prosperity through expanded opportunities, enhanced capabilities, stronger systems, and more resilient development pathways. The Hub is organized around three mutually reinforcing pillars / service lines: 1\) Multi\-dimensional Poverty, Inequalities and Capabilities; (2\) Jobs, Growth, and Structural Transformation; and (3\) HIV, Health and Inclusion.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Based in Madrid, the Head, Jobs, Growth and Transformation will lead the Hub’s second service line, providing senior\-level policy leadership, technical guidance and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation. The Head will support the development and delivery of an integrated offer that helps countries translate economic transformation, private sector development and investment into concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.


This service line responds to increasing country demand for support on the systemic enablers of job\-rich development, including productivity growth, trade, industrial and sectoral policy, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, skills systems, local economic development, and transitions from informal to formal work. It will help countries identify and address barriers within labour markets and enterprise ecosystems, while supporting emerging opportunities associated with green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions, including jobs of the future. Across this work, particular attention will be given to women, young people, informal workers, MSMEs and groups facing structural barriers to economic participation.


The incumbent provides leadership, policy direction and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation, and represents UNDP in the wider jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth community of practice, including with the UN system, international financial institutions, bilateral partners, external experts, private sector actors, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and other relevant stakeholders.


The incumbent facilitates and coordinates implementation support to the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub’s second service line. The incumbent ensures that UNDP’s offer on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation is informed by country demand, experience from the ground, and broader policy debates and analytical advances on job\-rich growth, productive transformation, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment, green and digital transitions, and inclusive economic opportunity. To this end, the Head provides substantive leadership in the relevant technical areas and leverages capacities across the Hub, Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs, Country Offices and the broader Global Policy Network.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to respond to evolving business needs and to harness synergies across interventions in pursuit of its strategic goals. This approach reflects the interconnected nature of development challenges, which require multidisciplinary teams and integrated, systemic responses. Therefore, the incumbent is expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects — collaborating horizontally across the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and with other parts of UNDP, including governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance — to enhance coherence, quality and impact.


Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Director, Prosperity and Wellbeing, the Head is responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:


1\) Substantive leadership and quality assurance of policy advice on jobs, growth and structural transformation:


* Provide substantive leadership in the analysis of drivers, opportunities and constraints for job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable economic transformation, with a focus on employment, livelihoods, productivity, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment and structural transformation.
* Lead the development of relevant, timely and innovation\-focused knowledge products, policy analysis, tools and guidance on jobs, growth and structural transformation, in close collaboration with relevant teams across BPPS and the organization.
* Ensure that UNDP’s policy advice on jobs and livelihoods is informed by country experience, high\-quality quantitative and qualitative data, economic and labour market analysis, and the latest global policy debates and evidence.
* Develop and present cutting\-edge policy options to governments and other development actors on employment\-intensive growth, productive transformation, private sector development, enterprise ecosystems, skills systems, local economic development, and green, blue, digital and AI\-related transitions.
* Lead intersectoral policy dialogue on jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth with governments, UN system partners, international financial institutions, donors, civil society, employers’ and workers’ organizations, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure quality assurance of policy and programme outputs related to the service line, including global, regional and country\-level initiatives.

2\) Provide high\-quality, timely and responsive technical and policy advice on prosperity and sustainable finance to Country Offices in the region:


* Provide substantive, timely, high\-quality and multidisciplinary policy and programme advisory services to Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices in response to country demand, including through analysis, policy options, programme design, implementation support and quality assurance.
* Advice and support countries to design integrated approaches that connect national growth strategies, private sector development, investment, trade, skills and enterprise development with concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.
* Advise on labour market diagnostics, jobs strategies, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, informal\-to\-formal transitions, skills development, local economic development, and employment opportunities linked to green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions.
* Identify new areas of engagement and opportunities for innovation, scaling and portfolio development to position UNDP as a relevant actor in line with emerging country demand.

**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 52,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Infrastructure decisions made at concept and design stages lock in decades of maintenance costs and operational risks. Programs that treat infrastructure operations and maintenance as a downstream concern inherit systems that are more costly to operate and fail more often.


The ideal candidate brings senior, hands\-on experience across the full lifecycle of high\-speed and conventional rail infrastructure: planning, design, construction, testing and commissioning, and long\-term operation and maintenance. Prior experience acting as technical authority or shadow operator, representing Infrastructure O\&M interests inside design and construction decisions.

  

Responsibilities:

* Leads infrastructure strategy and technical review for high\-speed and conventional rail programs, from concept through commissioning.
* Acts as technical authority and shadow operator.
* Represents infrastructure operations and maintenance interests in design and construction decisions.
* Directs the development of infrastructure maintenance concepts, rules, and OPEX models for track, systems, stations, and infrastructure maintenance facilities.
* Reviews designs and technical proposals for infrastructure constructability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost, identifying risks.
* Leads infrastructure value engineering across subsystems: civil works, track, energy, signalling, and control systems.
* Supports infrastructure testing and commissioning planning, and the technical handover of infrastructure from construction to operations.
* Coordinates multidisciplinary and multicultural teams across international programs.
* Interfaces directly with client leadership, planners, and designers to align infrastructure decisions with long\-term operational constraints.
* Contributes to bid development and technical proposals for new infrastructure and O\&M opportunities.

* Civil Engineering degree.

* Direct experience defining maintenance strategy and OPEX models for rail infrastructure and systems.
* International project experience, across multiple rail markets and multidisciplinary teams.
* Good communication skills.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Experience acting as technical authority or shadow operator representing infrastructure O\&M during design and construction.
* Master's degree in engineering management, business administration, or a related field.
* Experience in value engineering and design review from an infrastructure operational perspective.
* Experience supporting international bids and technical proposal development.
* Proficiency in a language beyond English and Spanish.

Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

* Engage and build relationships with relevant stakeholders, with regulators, policymakers, academia, civil society and industry bodies in the country of hire and across the EU
* Represent Meta at meetings and conferences

* Own project plans and strategic planning frameworks for privacy and AI external engagement initiatives

* Communications and knowledge management
* Shape internal communication strategies and channels on privacy and AI external engagement, in coordination with global counterparts
* Prepare briefing materials and presentations for senior audiences, including leadership policy and business updates on engagement and sentiment

* 6\+ years of professional experience in privacy, data or technology policy, regulatory affairs, or a closely related field

* Demonstrated expertise in AI policy and in the privacy and data protection framework of the EU digital landscape (GDPR, AI Act, DSA/DMA, Data Act)

* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional programmes, including business process management, workflow and lifecycle management
* Strong presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including those with senior external audiences

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience advising product or engineering teams on regulatory requirements

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimise/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Additional official EU languages to support stakeholder engagement across EU member states

* Experience working with or within an EU data protection authority, the EDPB, a national digital regulator, or an EU institution

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. title: Regional Chains Director
description:
**About WebBeds**



Launched in 2013, WebBeds is a global marketplace for the travel trade, providing powerful distribution solutions that make selling and buying travel products easier. It sources accommodation and destination services from travel suppliers, aggregates and merchandises that content in the WebBeds platform, then distributes it to its global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the travelling public.  

Hotels and other suppliers \- global and regional hotel chains, independent hotels, apartments, resorts, attractions, transfer and sightseeing companies and more \- can sell their products to a global network of online and offline travel buyers through robust solutions that provide greater inventory control to simplify distribution, and leverage WebBeds enhanced analytics to inform inventory optimisation choices – saving costs and increasing revenue.

  

Travel buyers \- online travel agencies, retail travel agents, corporate travel managers, tour operators, wholesalers, tourism boards, super apps, DMC’s, group providers, airlines and more \- can integrate the hundreds of thousands of hotels and ground services in the WebBeds marketplace through simple and seamless API connectivity, or they can search, shop and book online through one of WebBeds trade only booking sites.

  

WebBeds operates globally through four geographic regions – Europe, Asia Pacific, MEA (Middle East and Africa) and Americas \- with over 1,900 travel professionals working in 120 cities across 50 countries worldwide.

  

Find out more about the WebBeds business at www.webbeds.com  

WebBeds is a travel brand of the Web Travel Group (ASX: WEB).


**How will you make an impact?**



The Regional Chains Director is responsible for leading, developing, and executing the regional chain strategy to drive sustainable growth, strengthen strategic partnerships, and increase WebBeds’ market share across assigned regions.



This role owns the senior\-level relationships with key regional hotel chain partners and provides strategic direction to the Regional Chains team to maximize commercial performance, portfolio expansion, and long\-term value creation.



Working cross\-functionally with Global Chains, Contracting, Partner Success, Supplier Optimization, Connectivity, Sales, and Marketing teams, the Director ensures alignment between regional execution and global chain objectives. The role requires a strong commercial leader with deep industry expertise, strategic vision, and the ability to translate high\-level strategy into measurable results.



You will:


* Define and own the regional chain strategy, aligned with global chains objectives, to drive incremental revenue growth and market share.
* Lead and manage the Regional Chains team (\>4FTE), providing direction, coaching, and performance management to ensure delivery of agreed KPIs.
* Own senior\-level relationships with priority regional and global hotel chains, acting as executive sponsor and escalation point.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new chain opportunities within the region in collaboration with Global Chains and Regional Leadership.
* Ensure optimal commercial outcomes by overseeing chain contract negotiations, renewals, and compliance with agreed timelines and standards.
* Drive regional chain portfolio performance through pricing, availability, inventory, and product optimization in partnership with Partner Success, Supplier Optimization, and Contracting teams. Chair and participate in high\-level quarterly business reviews with key chain partners to review performance, align strategy, and identify growth opportunities.
* Collaborate with regional and destination contracting teams to ensure alignment on chain strategies, targets, and hotel\-level execution.
* Partner with supplier connectivity and loading teams to define preferred connectivity strategies and ensure scalable, high\-quality chain onboarding.
* Monitor regional chain performance trends, risks, and opportunities, using data\-driven insights to inform strategic decisions.
* Act as escalation point for complex commercial, service, or operational issues impacting regional chain partners.
* Drive the negotiation and execution of regional exclusives, value adds, overrides, and joint marketing initiatives across WebBeds platforms.
* Represent WebBeds at key industry events, tradeshows, and executive\-level partner meetings to strengthen market presence and relationships.
* Ensure effective internal communication and alignment between Global Chains, Sales, Marketing, and regional teams to maximize promotion of chain content.
* Support Health and Safety compliance and ensure required reporting is completed and up to date.
* Communicate internally and externally in a professional manner in line with corporate guidelines and leadership expectations.


**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**


* Extensive contracting and commercial experience within the hotel and/or travel industry.
* Proven ability to build, manage, and grow senior\-level strategic partnerships with hotel chains.
* Educated to degree level or equivalent professional qualification.
* Fluent in English (additional regional languages highly beneficial).
* Willingness to travel frequently within the region and internationally as required.
* Strong strategic leadership and people management skills, with experience leading multi\-market or regional teams.
* Excellent commercial acumen with a strong understanding of regional and global distribution models.
* Highly developed negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-maker with strong analytical capabilities and financial awareness.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to engage effectively at executive level.
* Proactive, resilient, and adaptable, with the ability to manage complexity and competing priorities. Collaborative leadership style with a strong focus on cross\-functional teamwork and accountability.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience in hotel contracting, chain management, or strategic commercial roles within OTAs, bedbanks, or tour operators.
* Strong understanding of dynamic and static contracting models across multiple regions. Fluency in one or more additional European languages.


**Why choose us as your next destination?**



We are super proud of our dedicated team of friendly, energetic \& passionate professionals. Our people are key to the success of our business \& everybody at WebBeds has their own unique role to play as we continue to drive the company forward.



Over 50 different languages are spoken by our workforce, but whether working from offices in Dubai or London or out in the field in Johannesburg or Buenos Aires, we all share the common goal to take pride in what we do \& to deliver our partners with unbeatable service \& support.


International highly skilled group of experts from all around the globe
Dynamic environment with the chance to grow, influence \& impact change
Disruptive, fast\-growing market leader within travel \& endless possibilities
Culture built on collaboration empowerment and innovation
  

Find out more about the WebBeds business at www.webbeds.com \- **\#LI\-Hybrid**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.



We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.

The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) supports the ongoing success of creators across the Twitch Partner program and plays a vital role in bringing new creators into the ecosystem. This role spans Creator Recruitment, Account Management, and Community Engagement, requiring a balance of analytical thinking and relationship management skills.



The role will work from Madrid, Spain and report into the Director of Global Spanish Partnerships.

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to high\-potential creators who are new to Twitch or transitioning to livestreaming

* Conduct stream reviews and support test\-streaming to ensure smooth creator starts
* Maintain visibility in emerging creator communities across platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, etc.

* Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of Twitch Partners
* Provide timely, high\-quality support and guidance on Twitch products, policies, and best practices

* Maintain active presence in Partner community spaces (e.g., Discord)

* Document creator insights and event outcomes


**Administrative \& Strategic Tasks**


* Generate and maintain reports on creator performance and engagement
* Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities within creator portfolio
* Participate in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives
* Support development of scalable solutions for creator needs


**Team Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and other teams
* Participate in regular team meetings and planning sessions
* Share insights and best practices with broader partnerships team
* Contribute to process improvements and team initiatives


**Success Metrics**


* Creator recruitment and onboarding targets
* Partner retention and satisfaction rates
* Response time and quality of support
* Event participation and outcomes
* Documentation quality and timeliness
* Cross\-functional collaboration effectiveness

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in client/partner management, content acquisition, or related fields
* Demonstrated experience in relationship management and business development
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* Fluency in English (written and verbal)

* Experience in digital media, gaming, or creator economy

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

  



**Our Purpose**


To foster positive change.

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset


We are looking for a person to join a full\-time position in **Madrid \- María de Molina.**

Equipment Circulation and technical support:* Manage new and existing video and post\-production equipment for student and faculty use.

One of the assets USSF uses to accomplish this mission is the Ground\-Based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) System.


This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).


Come join the team that provides this service to United States. You will help operate and maintain three (3\), one\-meter telescopes equipped with highly sensitive digital cameras. You’ll respond to Government tasking to obtain metric observations of specific objects daily and help maintain the sensors, support equipment, and the facility that houses it at Detachment 2, Naval Support Facility in Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).


This is a unique work\-site, so being a part of the Serco\-NA GEODSS Team, you will be offered Special Incentives:


* Free Internet,
* Meal allowances,
* Competitive salaries,
* Retention Bonus,
* Paid Time\-Off, and many more.

In this role, you will:


* Test, inspect, maintain, and repair assigned facilities, equipment, and systems in accordance with Operating Instructions (OIs), Preventive Maintenance Instructions (PMIs), manufacturer's instructions, specifications, drawings, and other applicable documents.
* Perform corrosion control and treatment functions as applicable to all assigned systems and equipment.
* Assure environmental pollution control and Hazardous Material (HAZMAT) directives and procedures are followed.
* Perform or support the development of maintenance documentation (PMIs, OIs, etc.) as directed, and performs documentation maintenance as applicable to assure all documentation is in a current state including maintenance and operations instructions and as\-built drawings.
* Maintain logs, records and inspection forms, which reflect equipment status, inspections and maintenance repair activities.
* Support the operation and maintenance of mission equipment and perform other duties such as logistics and transportation functions, general housekeeping, and roads and grounds maintenance.
* Assist with oversight and monitoring of facility upgrades.
* Perform duties as the primary Environmental Compliance Contact (ECC).
* Update, maintain and implement a site\-specific spill response plan.
* Create update and maintain a Det Emergency Response GOI.
* Operate, inspect, test, maintain and repair RP and all real property installed equipment (RPIE).
* Maintain inventory listings of all RPIE.
* Maintain and update maintenance manuals for all RPIE, Power Conditioning and Continuation Interface equipment (PCCIE) and ancillary equipment.
* Maintain and update RPIE drawings.
* Respond to emergency conditions within two hours and eliminate condition within 24 hours.
* Act as Backflow Prevention Manager; Implement a cross connection and backflow prevention program; inspect, test, install, repair and replace backflow prevention devices.
* Maintain HVAC systems.
* Perform duties as Equipment Custodian.
* Provide engineering services, technical support and design reviews.
* Manage the fire protection program.
* Request entomology support as needed.
* Provide safe ingress and egress on sidewalks and steps to the GEODSS building exits. Identify all snow removal and ice control requirements in writing.
* Maintain all areas in a clean, orderly and sanitary condition; Remove refuse from the GEODSS facilities and place in dumpsters provided by the Host Installation.
* Manage the receipt, storage, inspection, and distribution of HAZMAT brought onto the Det. Maintain MSDS and list of HAZMAT.
* Maintain keys and coordinate any key related requirements or issues with the Host.
* Maintain Non\-ILS\-S inventory items, shop stock, operating stock and ESD items.
* Maintain equipment accounts and supply point accountability at 100%.
* Act as primary DIFM Monitor, Bench Stock Monitor, Equipment Custodian, Supply Point Monitor, Shelf\-life Monitor, Precious Metals Recovery Program Monitor, Activity Supply Limited Inspector, Environmental Compliance Contact, and Records Custodian.
* Coordinate with Host Base(s) to assure adequate stocks are maintained.
* Coordinate and perform packing, crating, shipment of Government property, material pickup and delivery.
* Provide, as required, local purchase support.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to obtain/maintain an Active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* 3 years related experience in the operation, maintenance and repair of electrical systems, refrigeration, ventilation, and air conditioning systems.
	+ If performing the duties of the heating/plumbing mechanic, must have 3 years experience in the operation, maintenance, and repair of heating and plumbing systems.
* Completion of an accredited electrician trade school in air conditioning and refrigeration.
* Completion of accredited trade school in heating/plumbing mechanic.
* Must be able to work shift duty due to 24/7 operations environment.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.

  

Additional desired experience and skills:
* Top Secret Preferred
* Course in control circuits and protective devices desirable.
* Journeyman or Master Plumber license from any U.S. State, or completion of local journeyman plumber program.
* HVAC: EPA Universal HVAC certification.
* Backflow prevention: Certificated initial and refresher training from any state/local or Air Force approved certificated Backflow Prevention training program.

title: IFM Small Works Project Delivery Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

We are looking for an IFM Small Works Project Delivery Manager for our Integrated Facility Management business line.
  
  

About JLL
  
We're JLL. We're a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.
  
If you're looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you'll have a chance to innovate with the world's leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game\-changing real estate initiatives. You'll also make long\-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you'll be inspired by the best. We're focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL!
  
  

Role Purpose
  
We are seeking an experienced Project Delivery Manager to join the EMEA Small Works Program within the Engineering function. This role operates as a governance and subject matter expert (SME) resource, providing structured support to IFM teams across EMEA in the delivery of small\-scale capital projects — including building retrofits, refurbishments, workspace reconfigurations, and targeted facility improvements.
  
This is not a traditional end\-to\-end project management role. The primary function is to enable local FM teams to deliver projects compliantly, safely, and frugally by providing governance oversight, procurement guidance, technical SME support, and structured project frameworks. Direct end\-to\-end project delivery will only apply in cases deemed critical, high\-visibility, or where project complexity requires dedicated program\-level management.
  
The role sits within the EMEA Small Works Program and operates across a tiered delivery model:
  
Reports to \- EMEA Small Works Program Lead (Engineering)
  
  

What This Job Involves
  
Governance \& Compliance Oversight
  
Provide governance support to FM teams delivering Tier 2 projects, ensuring adherence to the Small Works framework, CAPEX governance processes, and client standards.
  
Support the triage process to ensure projects are correctly categorized within the tiered model and appropriately resourced.
  
Ensure EHS, legislative, and legal compliance requirements are actively governed across all supported projects, spanning multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
  
Monitor compliance with CDM regulations (where applicable), building regulations, health and safety requirements, and client\-specific standards.
  
Ensure workspace design standards and regulatory requirements are maintained throughout project delivery.
  
SME Support \& FM Team Enablement
  
Act as a subject matter expert resource for FM teams managing Tier 2 projects — providing guidance on project methodology, sequencing, risk management, and technical approach.
  
Provide procurement guidance to FM teams, ensuring competitive quotations are obtained from approved contractors and that works are delivered frugally within scope.
  
Coordinate SME input where specialist technical knowledge is required (mechanical, electrical, building fabric, sustainability).
  
Coach and support FM teams on the application of Small Works tools, templates, and governance standards for Tier 1 delivery.
  
Act as an escalation point for FM teams encountering project challenges, scope changes, or compliance queries.
  
Project Triage \& Categorization
  
Support the Small Works Program Lead in operating the triage process — assessing incoming project requests against complexity criteria to determine appropriate tier allocation.
  
Identify projects at risk of scope misclassification and ensure early intervention to prevent cost overruns or delivery failures.
  
Recommend escalation to WD\&C where project complexity exceeds Small Works scope.
  
Financial Oversight \& Procurement Guidance
  
Provide financial governance support for Tier 2 projects (typically sub\-€150K), ensuring budgets are realistic, tracked, and reported.
  
Guide FM teams on procurement processes, contractor selection, and cost control within approved frameworks.
  
Review and advise on variations, cost changes, and final accounts where FM teams require support.
  
Contribute to CAPEX forecasting and budget reporting for the Small Works portfolio within assigned geographic areas.
  
Direct Project Delivery (Critical/High\-Visibility Only)
  
Manage end\-to\-end delivery of projects designated as critical, high\-visibility, or requiring dedicated program\-level oversight.
  
Ensure these projects are completed on time, within budget, and to specification while minimizing disruption to building occupants.
  
Maintain comprehensive project records including correspondence, RFIs, site instructions, progress reports, and as\-built documentation for directly managed projects.
  
Stakeholder Management \& Coordination
  
Serve as a key interface between FM teams, the Small Works Program, WD\&C, and client stakeholders for Tier 2 projects.
  
Coordinate with WD\&C on project handoffs, triage decisions, and boundary management between projects.
  
Communicate project progress, risks, and governance status to the Small Works Program Lead and wider stakeholders.
  
Build effective working relationships with FM teams across assigned geographic areas to ensure the program is embedded and trusted.
  
Program Tools, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
  
Maintain and update the IFM Project Tracker for assigned projects and geographic areas.
  
Utilize and promote standardized Small Works templates, tools, and reporting mechanisms.
  
Report on program KPIs including speed of delivery, cost efficiency, safety and compliance, and quality consistency.
  
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in governance processes, tools, and FM team support mechanisms.
  
Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the Small Works framework.
  
  

Sound Like You? To Apply You Need to Have
  
Essential Qualifications \& Experience
  
Degree in Construction Management, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  
Minimum 3–5 years' experience in construction project management, building refurbishment, or facilities management — with demonstrable experience in governance, compliance oversight, or program support functions.
  
Experience supporting or enabling operational teams in the delivery of projects (not solely direct delivery experience).
  
Understanding of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building fabric.
  
Knowledge of building regulations, EHS requirements, and compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
  
Familiarity with CDM regulations and construction health and safety practices.
  
Experience with procurement processes, contractor management, and cost control.
  
Experience operating within a structured program or portfolio environment.
  
Essential Skills
  
Strong governance mindset — ability to apply frameworks consistently while remaining pragmatic.
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, particularly in enabling and influencing teams without direct authority.
  
Proficient in project planning, budgeting, and cost control.
  
Strong organizational skills with ability to oversee multiple concurrent projects across different sites and countries.
  
Problem\-solving mindset with a coaching and enablement approach.
  
Competent using MS Office, project management software, and digital collaboration tools.
  
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
  
Strong attention to detail and commitment to compliance and quality.
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
You'll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like\-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.
  
Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We'll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.
  
Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you...
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

You will also ensure reliable supply commitments, promote a culture of continuous improvement, and strengthen connections across OneMP areas and the broader network. Through your leadership, you will help deliver operational excellence while ensuring full compliance with cGxP requirements, safety standards, and regulatory expectations.

You will lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, ensuring the right resources, capabilities, and processes are in place to support the successful delivery of production and project objectives.

You will work closely with developers and product as a hands\-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly.

We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. title: Global Security Architect, Madrid
description:
Global Security Architect
  
The role sits in engineering. It reports to the Head of Information Security for mandate and standards, and spends its days with the teams that build the products, in the architecture forum, in design reviews, and alongside the Security Champions it coordinates. Its measure of success is that new products and material changes are secure by design, and that the same control is not reinvented twice.
  
  

Accountabilities
  
**Own the reference security patterns for Infronts products:** authentication and authorisation, encryption and key handling, secrets management, logging and telemetry, and secure service\-to\-service communication. Publish them, keep them current, and see them adopted.
  
Own the Secure Development Standard and the security gates in the build and deployment pipeline, including continuous scanning that covers components embedded in Infronts own software, not only what is installed on hosts.
  
Lead threat modelling and security design review for new products and material changes, proportionate to risk, and record the outcome so it is auditable.
  
Be the technical lead for identity architecture across the estate: the enterprise identity provider, the product authentication platform and the trading authorisation layer, including succession planning for platforms that today depend on a single person.
  
Own security architecture for the cloud estate, across multiple AWS accounts and Azure tenants, and for the boundary between shared and isolated platform instances.
  
Coordinate the Security Champions, one named engineer per product area, as a dotted\-line community: set their agenda, give them patterns to apply, and use them to reach every team.
  
Represent security in the architecture forum and in the Cyber Resilience Act secure\-by\-design work, and translate regulatory expectations into engineering decisions.
  
Provide the application\-layer input to vulnerability prioritisation and penetration test scoping, so that testing concentrates on the shared components most products depend on.
  
  

What you will do in the first six months
  
Publish the first three reference patterns, encryption, authentication and secrets, and get them adopted by at least one product team each.
  
Enable continuous pipeline scanning for embedded components across the priority products, with a named owner for findings in each team.
  
Produce the identity architecture and succession plan for the product authentication and authorisation platforms.
  
Stand up the Security Champions community with a named champion in every product area and a monthly cadence.
  
Consolidate Infronts four overlapping secure development policy drafts into one standard that engineers will actually use.
  
Complete threat models for the five shared components on which most priority products depend.
  
Experience and skills, essential
  
Substantial experience designing security into software products, in a company that builds and operates its own platforms, ideally financial technology or another regulated SaaS environment.
  
**Hands\-on depth in application security and secure development:** threat modelling, OWASP\-aligned secure coding, SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI/CD, and what it takes to get engineers to adopt them.
  
Cloud security architecture across AWS and Azure, including multi\-account governance, container platforms and infrastructure as code.
  
**Identity and access architecture:** enterprise identity providers, single sign\-on, OAuth and OIDC, and product\-level authentication platforms of the Keycloak type.
  
**Cryptography applied in practice:** what to use, where, and how to manage keys and certificates, rather than theory.
  
The credibility to influence engineers without line authority, and the judgement to know when a pattern must be mandatory and when it can be guidance.
  
Fluent English.
  
Familiarity with DORA and the Cyber Resilience Act as they apply to a technology supplier to financial institutions.
  
  

OWASP, SAST, SCA, Cloud Security AWS/Azure, OAuth, OIDC

Are you looking for a role where your commissioning expertise can make a real difference for children, young people and families?



Join Bracknell Forest and play a key role in the Children’s Strategic Commissioning Team, helping to shape high\-quality services, build strong partnerships and deliver positive outcomes and value for money for our residents.



At Bracknell Forest, we pride ourselves on being a council which is stable and well\-managed where our employees can thrive in a supportive environment. We understand the importance of a healthy work\-life balance and offer a variety of flexible working practices, including options for remote working and arrangements that allow you to work from home, dependent on the needs of the service. This role includes an expectation to work from our Time Square office 1\-2 days per week, alongside flexible working arrangements.



Any successful internal candidate will be offered the position as a secondment and, in line with Section 8\.1 of the Secondment Policy, must consult with their manager before applying. Search ‘secondment policy’ on the intranet for more information.


### **About you…**



As a Senior Commissioner you will have experience of working within a commissioning, contract management or related environment, with the ability to contribute effectively across the commissioning cycle and support the delivery of positive outcomes and value for money for children, young people and residents.



With strong analytical, negotiation and problem\-solving skills, you will be able to develop and contribute to commissioning strategies and priorities, with an understanding of the challenges and opportunities within SEND services and Education Transport. This will include leading provider monitoring activity, responding confidently to performance and contractual concerns and negotiating effectively to secure positive outcomes and value for money.



A creative, solutions\-focused and adaptable professional, you will be confident working collaboratively with colleagues, providers and partners. You will have the ability to bring together resources, expertise and different perspectives to overcome challenges and identify practical solutions, while working professionally and effectively.


### **About the team…**



Bracknell Forest Council is a forward\-thinking and supportive organisation, where friendly and committed colleagues work together to deliver meaningful outcomes for our communities. We are ambitious in our approach and value innovation, collaboration and planning ahead to meet the changing needs of our residents.



The Children’s Strategic Commissioning Team plays a key role in shaping and delivering high\-quality, effective services for children and young people. We work closely with partners and providers to understand local needs, develop strategic priorities and ensure services deliver positive outcomes and value for money. Joining the team, you will have the opportunity to influence these priorities and contribute to services that make a lasting difference to children, young people and families.


### **Key responsibilities…**



Reporting to the Strategic Commissioning Manager you will:


* ensure all aspects of the commissioning cycle are implemented in a consistent, safe and efficient way to support excellent outcomes for our residents and deliver outstanding value for money.
* manage a portfolio of projects, ensuring delivery in line with project plans; facilitate and lead project groups; and ensure accountability for tasks to achieve timely objectives.
* take responsibility for significant, high\-value projects, commissioning reviews, change management and contract management.
* provide advice, support and review papers, including clear options appraisals, to senior managers and Assistant Directors across the council.
* build strong relationships and effective working partnerships in relation to commissioning and the strategic development of service areas.

* Inclusive and social working environment with a variety of staff networks and a sports and social club.

  


### **Our values**



At Bracknell Forest Council our values define who we are and what is important to us. Our core values are inclusive, ambitious, and always learning. These values influence the way we work with each other and the way we serve our residents and engage with our communities. We make our values real by demonstrating them in how we behave every day.
