title: Director, Solutions Design Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**



Are you passionate about developing innovative supply chain solutions that accelerate business growth, drive operational excellence, and create long\-term value for customers? ID Logistics is seeking a Senior Director, Solutions Engineering to lead complex solution design initiatives across North America while serving as a strategic partner to Commercial, Operations, Finance, IT, and Customer Implementation teams. Reporting to senior leadership within Research \& Development Department, this role primarily focuses on new business opportunities ensuring solution designs are operationally sound, financially viable, and aligned with customer requirements.



The Director, Solutions Engineering is responsible for owning the design, development, and validation of large\-scale distribution, fulfillment, transportation, automation, and network optimization solutions that support new business pursuits, customer expansions, contract renewals, and operational transformations. They will provide leadership across the solution development lifecycle, combining engineering expertise, financial acumen, customer engagement, and team leadership to deliver scalable logistics solutions that align with both customer requirements and business objectives.



The ideal candidate brings extensive distribution center design experience, previous ownership of complex RFQ/RFI processes, advanced engineering and operational modeling capabilities, a proven track record leading high\-impact supply chain transformation initiatives, and in\-depth experience with customer implementations.



Multiple opportunities are available within our Solutions Design organization. We are actively recruiting for positions at various levels, each with distinct scope, responsibilities, and experience requirements. Candidates may see multiple related openings and are encouraged to apply for the role that best aligns with their background and career goals.


**Work Location:** Hybrid in Johns Creek, GA. Relocation assistance will be considered on case by case basis


**Work Schedule:** Monday\- Friday, 8:00am \- 5pm


**Work Travel:** Up to 25%, with occasional periods of 50% depending on business needs and subject to change


**Competitive Compensation:** $124,000\-$160,000 plus performance based annual bonus


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Solution Design Leadership**


* Lead the design and development of comprehensive logistics solutions supporting new business opportunities, customer expansions, network redesigns, facility start\-ups, contract renewals, automation initiatives, and operational transformations.
* Design and optimize warehouse layouts, storage strategies, material handling flows, and operational processes for steady\-state, ramp\-up, and seasonality.
* Conduct labor modeling, capacity planning, productivity analysis, workflow design, and operational assessments to support customer requirements.
* Develop innovative supply chain solutions that leverage automation, technology, and best practices to improve productivity and service performance.
* Perform return on investment (ROI), capital expenditure, and operational cost analyses to support solution recommendations.
* Ensure all proposed solutions align with operational capabilities, customer expectations, financial objectives, and long\-term scalability.
* Validate operational assumptions, engineering designs, labor requirements, and financial models prior to customer presentation and implementation.
* Manage and oversee projects completed by other engineers to validate operational design, productivity, customer requirements, and financials.


**Commercial \& Business Development Support**


* Serve as a strategic engineering partner for commercial and operational team throughout the logistics sales lifecycle.
* Lead solution design activities associated with Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Proposal (RFP), and Requests for Quotation (RFQ) opportunities
* Develop cost models, labor assumptions, throughput projections, and pricing strategies for new business opportunities and renewals.
* Partner with Commercial and Finance leadership on pricing strategies, business case development, and investment recommendations.
* Support proposal development, customer presentations, solution reviews, site visits, operational assessments, and executive discussions.
* Collaborate with customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, growth forecasts, and service requirements.
* Validate commercial conditions, presentations, and financials on projects completed by other engineers


**Engineering Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain engineering standards, methodologies, design tools, templates, and best practices across the solutions engineering function.
* Lead value engineering initiatives focused on improving productivity, service levels, safety, quality, and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate automation technologies, robotics, material handling equipment, ASRS systems, goods\-to\-person solutions, and emerging supply chain technologies.
* Identify opportunities for network optimization, transportation improvements, inventory flow enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
* Drive data\-driven decision making through advanced analytics and operational modeling.
* Support implementation teams during customer onboarding, facility launches, and major operational transitions.


**Team and Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Develop and train a team of solutions engineering professionals with various degrees of experience.
* Provide coaching and technical guidance to solutions engineering team members.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams supporting strategic customer initiatives and business growth objectives.
* Partner with Operations, Commercial, Finance, IT, Customer Implementation, and Procurement teams to develop integrated supply chain solutions.
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, equipment providers, consultants, and external partners as required.
* Support the development and standardization of engineering methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Actively promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.


**Project Governance \& Customer Implementation Support**


* Manage, and oversee multiple concurrent engineering projects with significant operational and financial impact, while meeting deadlines and customer expectations.
* Monitor project milestones, engineering deliverables, assumptions, risks, business outcomes, and financial impacts.
* Support implementation and operations teams during customer launches, facility start\-ups, and major operational transitions.
* Present strategic solution recommendations and business cases to leadership and customers.
* Collaborate with equipment suppliers, consultants, technology vendors, and external partners to support engineering initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company safety standards, operational best practices, and customer and quality requirements.

Requirements:
**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering preferred; suitable candidates may have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in solutions engineering, industrial engineering, logistics engineering, supply chain consulting, warehouse design, operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing solution design functions, or complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Extensive solution design experience required. Experience, preferably within a third\-party logistics (3PL) organization.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale distribution, fulfillment, and supply chain solution development efforts, including labor modeling, process optimization, facility layout development, and financial costing.
* Demonstrated expertise in labor modeling, warehouse design, process optimization, facility layout development, capacity planning, and operational costing.
* Significant experience leading complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP responses, including solution development, pricing support, customer presentations, and contract pursuits.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, distribution center designs, transportation networks, inventory strategies, material handling systems, automation, and supply chain technologies.
* Expertise with Microsoft Excel, proficiency with AutoCAD, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools. Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) experience is a plus.
* Exceptional analytical, project management, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and customer\-facing skills.
* Ability to own and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Understanding of financial modeling, ROI analysis, and capital investment evaluation experience.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, with occasional periods of 50%.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience supporting highly complex operations within e\-commerce, omnichannel retail, consumer packaged goods (CPG), fashion, healthcare, automotive, industrial, food \& beverage, or consumer electronics sectors.
* Experience leading regional, national, or multi\-site solution design organizations Demonstrated experience evaluating and implementing automation technologies, robotics, autonomous systems, and advanced material handling solutions.
* Experience with network modeling, transportation optimization, facility location analysis, and supply chain strategy initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, APICS/ASCM, or similar professional certifications preferred.
* Experience supporting operations exceeding one million square feet, highly automated environments, or large\-scale enterprise logistics transformations preferred.

  




  

Req Benefits: ID Logistics offers a generous benefits package for eligible associates to include 401K with match, Health, Vision, Dental and vacation and sick time, among other competitive benefits. Compensation is determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, internal equity, and geographic location. The posted range is presented to illustrate variables within these factors.

title: Paid Social Marketing Manager
description:
**Who we are:**



At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast\-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.



We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.



Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

 **Who We're Looking for:**

As Paid Social Marketing Manager, US and International, you'll lead paid media strategy across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and emerging platforms such as Twitch. You'll manage a full\-funnel budget: high\-efficiency direct response campaigns at the lower funnel, brand\-building and awareness work at the upper funnel, across the US, Canada, UK, and emerging EU markets. Reporting to the Director of Upper Funnel Marketing, you'll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, brand storytelling, and influencer partnerships, making sure the paid budget amplifies what's already working organically and while ensuring a cohesive brand experience across marketing touchpoints.


*This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Downtown Seattle Office two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in the Greater Seattle Area or willing to relocate.*  


### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Own new\-customer and awareness goals for your channels across the US, Canada, UK, and emerging EU markets, holding CAC to the LTV\-based payback target for each channel.
* Plan, build, and optimize paid social campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager etc. owning budget pacing, audience strategy, and creative testing.
* Own organic campaign boosting. Partner with Brand (Organic) Social team to find top\-performing organic posts and creator content to extend their reach and get the most value out of every partnership.
* Build and maintain one shared campaign calendar that lines up with influencer and brand social drops so a campaign launch reads as one story wherever a customer sees it.
* Brief creative and run a structured testing framework across taglines, formats, and audiences. Use data, not gut feel, to decide what scales and what gets cut.
* Responsible for reporting across paid and boosted content, turning metrics such as CAC, ROAS, reach (views/impressions) and engagement rate into strong recommendations for leadership.
* Track platform changes and best practices on Meta, Reddit,Snapchat and TikTok, covering attribution, privacy, and new ad formats, and translate what they mean for media buying and for influencer partnership terms such as usage rights, disclosure, and contracts.
* Work with Brand, Influencer, and PR to keep messaging consistent everywhere a pet parent might find us.
* Run incrementality tests for your channels working alongside Marketing Analytic team mates, including geo\-uplift studies and MMM holdouts. Use the results to prove which spend drives real new customers, not organic or brand halo effects.
* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with paid social agency partners, holding them accountable for strategy, execution, and performance against goals.
### **Your Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years managing $5M\+ paid social budgets across Meta, Reddit, Snapchat and TikTok, with a track record of balancing direct response and upper\-funnel brand metrics.
* Experience executing campaigns across the US and international regions, specifically Canada, the UK, and the EU.
* Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and translating platform jargon into clear, high\-level recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree required. A master's degree in a quantitative or business field is a plus, and equivalent work experience counts too.
* Direct experience managing agencies, running RFP processes, validating their work, and holding them accountable.
* Experience working alongside influencer and creator marketing. You know the difference between paid social, paid partnerships, and whitelisting, and you understand usage rights.
* A track record with ecommerce or marketplace brands, fluent in both funnel metrics such as ROAS, CAC, LTV, and CPM, and brand health metrics such as awareness and consideration.
* **Measurement Fluency:** Hands\-on experience implementing geo\-uplift testing and turning MMM results into action.
* **Creative Cohesion:** A strong grasp of the customer journey and why consistency matters. You architect one organic and paid perspective across every customer touchpoint.
* **Channel Expertise:** A strong point of view on channel and creative best practices, backed by data, that you're comfortable advocating for.
* **FTC Expertise:** Fluency in platform ad policies and FTC disclosure requirements for creator and whitelisted content.
* **Collaboration:** A genuinely collaborative streak. You work fluently with Brand and Marketing Data Science, speaking creative or data depending on the audience, and you'd rather build one great campaign with three teams than guard your own lane.
* **AI/Automation Mastery:** You've used scripts, Python, SaaS tools, and AI to improve workflow automation giving yourself real capacity gains.
* **A Sense of Curiosity:** Genuine excitement to learn new things and to keep challenging your own thinking.
### **Nice to Haves:**


* Experience with pet, or on\-demand marketplace brands specifically.
* A dog, cat, or other creature who 'helps' you work from home (photographic evidence welcomed, not required).
### **Benefits of Working at Rover.com:**


* Competitive compensation
* 401k match
* Long\-term incentive plan with a company performance\-based cash payout
* Flexible PTO
* Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Commuter benefits
* Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
* Pet benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog or cat
* Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches monthly
* Regular team activities performed in\-person and virtually
### **Compensation:**


* In the greater Seattle area the first\-year salary range is $129,139\-$171,755\. Additionally, Rover offers benefits to full\-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We aren't for the faint of heart! We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. And the industry notices: We were recently named an **Inc. Best Workplace 2026** and landed on the **Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies for 2026**!

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family\-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full\-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

**Our Dream Team Member:**

* A strategic thinker who sees the whole board, not just the next deadline
* Trusted by clients, and the first call when something matters
* A creative who can start from a blank page and come back with an idea nobody expected
* A steady leader who develops people instead of just assigning them work
* Comfortable across disciplines, and fluent enough in influencer, paid and affiliate to build a real integrated plan
* A real media person with relationships worth something and a pitch that lands
* Commercially minded about scopes, budgets and where the growth is

* Calm under pressure and direct when something needs to be said
* Passionate about staying ahead of trends in the CPG and F\&B space

**Position Overview:**


The **Account Director** leads integrated programs for the agency's largest clients, owning strategy, creative direction and the client relationship from planning through delivery. The role sits above the account supervisor level and reports into earned media leadership. It spans strategic counsel, creative campaign development, team leadership, and cross\-department coordination across PR, influencer, affiliate, paid and events. We're looking for someone who leads rather than supports, and who is excited to use new tools, including AI, to work smarter.

**What You'll Do:**

*Client Leadership:*

* Serve as the senior day\-to\-day contact on the agency's largest integrated accounts
* Provide ongoing, consistent strategic counsel that builds client trust
* Present recommendations, plans and results to client leadership
* Own the health of the account, including scope, budget and renewal conversations alongside agency leadership

* Own the earned media strategy on your accounts: the story angles, the target outlets, and the pitching calendar

* Build and maintain real relationships with editors, producers, freelancers and influencers in the consumer and family space
* Direct media list development and quality control the team's pitches before they go out
* Coach junior staff on pitch writing, follow\-up, and building their own media relationships
* Lead media training and briefing document development for client spokespeople and experts

* Know when a story is worth chasing and when it isn't, and spend the team's hours accordingly

*Awards:*

* Oversee client media awards programs and set the submission strategy

*Team Leadership:*

* Supervise and mentor team members at all levels
* Delegate meaningful work and give constructive, timely feedback
* Foster a collaborative and productive remote work environment

*Project Management:*

* Own campaign and account timelines from kickoff through delivery across multiple workstreams
* Track deliverables, budgets, staffing and team responsibilities
* Responsible for quality control and on\-time delivery of the team's work
* Flag risks and staffing gaps before they become problems

*Technology \& AI:*

* Actively use AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, and similar) to support research, drafting, monitoring and reporting
* Test and adopt new software and platforms, and share what works with the team
* Stay current on how search and AI are changing brand discovery, and bring that thinking into client plans

*New Business:*

* Contribute strategy and creative thinking to new business pitches
* Help build and present pitch materials
* Identify organic growth opportunities within existing accounts

*Events / Activations:*

* Lead virtual or live media and influencer events, creative media mailers, and more
* Develop decks and lead client presentations

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
* 8\+ years of agency experience in the consumer, lifestyle or CPG space
* Demonstrated experience as a day\-to\-day client lead, not solely a contributor
* Experience managing and developing people
* Working knowledge across at least a few of: earned media, influencer, affiliate, paid media, events
* Strong, current media relationships and a portfolio of top\-tier placements you secured yourself
* Hands\-on experience writing pitches and press materials that get picked up, not just reviewing someone else's
* Fluency with media databases and monitoring tools such as MuckRack, Cision or Qwoted
* Comfortable using AI tools day to day, with examples of how you've used them
* A real willingness to try new technologies and adopt new tools quickly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* A proactive, self\-starter attitude with a passion for staying ahead of trends
* Preferred: affiliate platform experience (LTK, ShopMy, Impact) and experience in baby, parenting, toys or wellness categories

**Benefits:**

* Unlimited PTO
* Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
* Fabulous Fridays, the office closes at 3 pm!
* 401K with a 3% company match, after your initial 3 months
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA
* Company\-paid Life Insurance
* Company\-paid Long Term Disability

$95,000 \- $110,000

**YOUR ROLE \& IMPACT AT ASG**


As part of a purposeful team at Archipelago Strategies Group, Inc. (ASG), the Digital \& Creator Marketing Manager leads the development, execution, and optimization of digital marketing strategies across multiple client accounts. This role is responsible for managing the digital components of integrated campaigns, including paid digital advertising, social media, YouTube and video advertising, email marketing, content marketing, website initiatives, and creator and influencer marketing.


The Digital \& Creator Marketing Manager works across ASG teams to translate client goals and broader campaign strategies into coordinated digital plans. They partner closely with Creative, Media, Communications, Community Engagement, and Client Services to ensure digital initiatives are strategically aligned, delivered on time, and optimized throughout the campaign.


The role combines strong digital campaign management with an understanding of how audiences discover information, consume content, engage with creators, and take action online. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple digital workstreams, developing platform and content strategies, identifying and managing creator partnerships, reviewing campaign performance, and using data and audience insights to continuously improve results.


The ideal candidate will have 7\+ years of experience managing and executing digital marketing campaigns, preferably in an agency environment, with demonstrated experience across digital advertising, social and content marketing, campaign analytics and optimization, and creator or influencer marketing. Experience developing culturally relevant and audience\-specific strategies for diverse communities is strongly preferred.


**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Digital Marketing Strategy \& Campaign Management**

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies across multiple client accounts, translating broader marketing and communications goals into actionable digital plans.
* Recommend the appropriate mix of social media, creator marketing, paid digital, video, search, email, web, and other digital channels based on campaign objectives and target audiences.
* Manage digital campaign calendars, content distribution plans, audience strategies, deliverables, timelines, and approvals.
* Partner with Creative, Media, Communications, Community Engagement, and Client Services to ensure digital initiatives are aligned, delivered on time, and within budget.
* Identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, conversion, and campaign performance throughout the campaign lifecycle.

**Creator, Influencer \& Social Media Marketing**

* Lead creator and influencer marketing strategies from identification and outreach through content development, approval, publishing, and performance measurement.
* Identify and evaluate creators, influencers, community voices, and digital partners based on audience relevance, engagement, cultural credibility, geography, brand alignment, and campaign goals.
* Develop creator briefs and manage deliverables, timelines, approvals, usage rights, and campaign requirements.
* Build and maintain relationships with multicultural and multilingual creators and creator networks.
* Develop platform\-specific social strategies across channels such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Partner with Creative to develop digital\-first content, including short\-form video, social assets, and creator\-generated content, and identify opportunities to amplify high\-performing content through paid media.

**Paid Digital, Website \& Email Marketing**

* Work closely with ASG's Media team to develop paid digital recommendations, including platforms, audiences, geography, creative formats, and campaign sequencing.
* Support campaigns across platforms such as Meta, YouTube, Google, TikTok, streaming, programmatic, and emerging digital channels.
* Manage and support website and landing\-page initiatives, content updates, user experience improvements, and SEO best practices.
* Develop and manage email marketing campaigns, including segmentation, content, testing, deployment, automation, and optimization using platforms such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar tools.
* Ensure website, email, paid media, social, and creator activities work together as part of an integrated audience journey.




**Measurement, Optimization \& Reporting**

* Establish meaningful KPIs for digital, social, and creator marketing campaigns.
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance across relevant metrics, including reach, engagement, video performance, click\-through rates, conversions, website activity, email performance, and creator results.
* Translate data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
* Test and optimize creative, messaging, audiences, formats, channels, and calls to action based on campaign performance.
* Contribute digital and creator marketing insights to client reports, presentations, and strategic recommendations.

**Client \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as a knowledgeable digital and creator marketing resource for clients and internal teams.
* Participate in client meetings and clearly communicate strategies, recommendations, results, and opportunities.
* Manage multiple digital and creator workstreams simultaneously, anticipating issues and proactively identifying solutions.
* Bring digital and creator considerations into integrated campaign planning from the beginning.
* Maintain strong coordination across ASG teams and external partners to ensure high\-quality execution.

**Innovation \& Capability Building**

* Stay current on social platforms, creator marketing, AI\-enabled marketing tools, advertising technology, privacy, audience behavior, and emerging digital trends.
* Identify new tools, approaches, platforms, and opportunities that can strengthen client campaigns.
* Help develop ASG's creator networks, internal resources, best practices, templates, and workflows.




**YOUR MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** BS/BA degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
* **Experience:** 7\+ years of experience in digital marketing, social media, creator/influencer marketing, integrated marketing, or a related field. Agency experience strongly preferred.
* **Creator Marketing:** Demonstrated experience developing or managing influencer, creator, ambassador, or community\-driven marketing campaigns.
* **Digital Strategy:** Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing and how paid, organic, creator, social, video, search, email, and web channels work together.
* **Social Media:** Advanced understanding of major social platforms including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, including platform\-specific content and audience behaviors.
* **Paid Digital:** Working knowledge of paid social, paid search, video, programmatic, and digital audience targeting. Direct media\-buying experience is valuable but not required.
* **Content:** Strong understanding of digital\-first content development, particularly short\-form video and creator\-generated content.
* **Analytics:** Ability to interpret digital campaign data and translate performance into actionable recommendations.
* **Project Management:** Demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns, deliverables, creators, deadlines, and internal stakeholders simultaneously.
* **Client Service:** Ability to confidently communicate recommendations, strategy, and performance to clients.
* **Cultural Competency:** Ability to develop marketing strategies for culturally, linguistically, and geographically diverse audiences.
* **Language Skills:** Bilingual or multilingual capabilities, particularly Spanish, Portuguese, or Haitian Creole, are strongly preferred but not required.

**YOUR COMPETENCIES AND TRAITS**

* **Digital Curiosity:** You actively follow changes in platforms, culture, creators, technology, and audience behavior and understand how those changes affect marketing.
* **Cultural Intelligence:** You understand that reaching diverse audiences requires more than translation and bring cultural relevance into strategy, content, creator selection, and execution.
* **Strategic Thinking:** You connect audience insights, client objectives, channels, content, creators, and data into a cohesive strategy.
* **Creative Judgment:** You recognize strong content, understand what works on different platforms, and can provide thoughtful direction without stripping content of authenticity.
* **Communication:** You communicate complex information clearly and adapt your communication style across clients, creators, colleagues, and partners.
* **Reliability \& Ownership:** You take responsibility for deliverables, anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and proactively solve problems.
* **Quality:** You maintain strong attention to detail across content, creator deliverables, reporting, campaign setup, and client\-facing work.
* **Problem Solving \& Decision Making:** You combine data, judgment, creativity, and audience understanding to make informed decisions.
* **Time \& Project Management:** You successfully manage multiple campaigns and priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** You work effectively across creative, media, communications, community engagement, research, and client services teams.
* **Operational Excellence:** You create repeatable processes and use performance data to continuously improve the quality and efficiency of ASG's digital and creator marketing work.

**WHO WE ARE \& WHAT WE DO**

* ASG,established in 2013, is an integrated marketing agency that powers progress for corporations, nonprofits, government agencies, and the communities they serve. We build data\-driven campaigns and community\-centered engagement that reach the right people, inspire action, and improve lives. By coordinating research, creative, communications, media, a multilingual customer center, and on\-the\-ground engagement in a single team, ASG delivers precise targeting, rapid response, and results you can measure. From raising health\-coverage enrollment by 25 percent to securing community support for clean\-energy upgrades, we efficiently and transparently turn insight into impact. Clients choose ASG because we listen first, move nimbly, and stay accountable every step of the way.


ASG is a certified minority, woman and LGBTQ\-owned business enterprise. Our team is also culturally diverse, and a majority of our staff are multilingual, enabling ASG to connect with key stakeholders in their native languages. ASG has received accolades such as the U.S. SBA’s Minority\-Owned Small Business of the Year and recognition from the Boston Business Journal as one of Massachusetts’s 'Fast 50' growing private companies and one of the state’s most diverse employers. With ambitious growth goals, we aim to expand our offerings both operationally and geographically, so that we can continue to purposefully impact diverse communities through our integrated social marketing.

**OUR PROMISE**


If you are passionate about working for a growing organization that values authenticity, passion, helping others, diversity, and inquisitiveness, you will find your career rewarding and impactful at ASG. As Digital \& Creator Marketing Manager you will be part of a dynamic team and will find a partner in your career path goals and trajectory!

**OUR BENEFITS \& PERKS**
* **Base Salary**: Salary range for this position is commensurate with experience.
* **Vacation, Sick, AND Floating Days:** Receive generous vacation time that increases throughout your tenure and frontloaded Sick and Floating Days!
* **12 Company Holidays**
* **Health, Dental, and Vision Plans:** Choose from an array of high\-quality plans for you and your family.
* **Employer Paid Life and Long\-Term Disability Insurance**
* **401K \+ Match:** 401K plan with an employer match after 90 days of employment and financial literacy services provided through our retirement provider.
* **Professional Development:** In\-house training, annual organizational retreats, and more!
* **Hybrid Workplace:** Enjoy a remote first workplace, with in person duties required as needed for client meetings, events, activations, project work, role tasks, and internal meetings

title: Communications Manager
description:
**Role:** 
 Communications Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Mexico City, Mexico (remote, with weekly in\-person syncs)
 



**Working pattern:** 
 EST overlap required
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Head of Marketing
 



  





**ABOUT COSIGN** 




  






 Cosign is the fastest growing prop\-tech company in the United States revolutionizing the $4 trillion rental industry with a market\-leading one\-of\-a\-kind rent guarantee product. Our mission is to expand housing access for renters and boost occupancy for landlords. Backed by top entrepreneurs, venture capital firms, and real estate investors, Cosign is built by experienced landlords and managers for landlords and managers who deeply understand the rental market's needs.
 



  





**OUR MISSION CONTINUED** 




  





 Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We're building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify, expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases.
 



  





**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY** 




  





 At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity, individuals who:
 



  




* Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
* Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
* Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
* Create innovative solutions others believe impossible



  





 We deliberately seek these rare, high\-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.
 



  





 We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




  





 Calling all storytellers and brand builders. We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on Communications Manager who can own how Cosign shows up everywhere, externally and internally, from leadership's LinkedIn to the sales deck in a rep's hand. You will build the communications function from the ground up and define how Cosign sounds at every touchpoint.
 



  





 As our first
 
 Communications Manager
 
 , you will own the entire stack: owned\-channel strategy across LinkedIn, blog, website, PR, and executive communications, plus the messaging frameworks, sales collateral, and enablement materials that arm Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to sell with confidence. You will build the content engine behind our executive thought leadership and our Partnerships team's outreach, while partnering closely with leadership to keep every customer\-facing message clear, consistent, and on\-position.
 



  





 Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this is a player\-coach role: you'll ship high\-stakes content yourself while coaching and upskilling a Copywriter, raising the bar for every piece of writing that leaves the company. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has built a communications function from 0 to 1 before, and is excited to own the full narrative, inside and outside the company, in a fast\-moving, early\-stage context.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Own Cosign's external communications engine across LinkedIn, the website, blog, PR, executive communications, and every customer\-facing channel, ensuring a consistent, compelling brand voice at every touchpoint
* Own the communications strategy end\-to\-end: editorial direction, messaging frameworks, brand voice, content planning, and cross\-functional alignment across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success
* Build executive thought leadership that positions Cosign as an industry leader: managing leadership's LinkedIn presence, executive content, presentations, speeches, interviews, and other public\-facing communications
* Drive the content and SEO strategy that builds awareness and authority: owning website messaging, blog content, organic growth, and continuously improving search performance in partnership with our design lead
* Lead PR, strategic communications, and high\-impact initiatives: partnering with the Head of Marketing on media opportunities, AI\-driven marketing initiatives, product launches, and company\-wide communications projects
* Own sales enablement and internal messaging from strategy to execution: creating and maintaining presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, sales templates, launch communications, FAQs, webinars, and messaging documentation, ensuring every team tells a consistent story to prospects, customers, partners, and investors
* Coach and develop our Copywriter as a player\-coach: setting the quality bar, giving structured feedback, and upskilling them on voice, AI\-assisted workflows, and editorial judgment



  





**ABOUT YOU** 




  





 As a highly motivated and data\-driven communications expert, you take full ownership of the communications function, from messaging strategy to final content execution, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to your targets, remain structured under pressure, and distinguish true impact from mere output.
 



  





 You thrive in early\-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to innovate, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it.
 



  





 You are a storyteller at heart, comfortable adapting your voice across executives, customers, partners, media, and internal teams, and using SEO insights and AI to drive the highest\-performing content.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 




  





 We are looking for a passionate communications leader who is excited to shape Cosign's voice and build a world\-class communications function from the ground up.
 



  




* 3\-5\+ years of experience in Communications, Content Marketing, Corporate Communications, Editorial, Brand Marketing, or a related field, ideally within a startup environment
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with experience creating content for executives, customers, sales teams, partners, and media while maintaining a consistent brand voice
* Proven experience building executive thought leadership, particularly on LinkedIn, and growing organic brand presence through strategic content
* Hands\-on ownership of website content, company blogs, editorial calendars, and SEO\-driven content strategies using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console
* Strong AI fluency, leveraging tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to accelerate research, content creation, and editing workflows
* Experience creating sales enablement materials, including presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and messaging frameworks, that support revenue teams throughout the customer journey
* Excellent project management skills, with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and managing editorial workflows using tools like Notion, Asana, or similar platforms
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and the ability to influence Product, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders without formal authority
* A passion for building systems from scratch, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest\-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will shape how Cosign communicates with the world, building the voice, content engine, and communications strategy that define our brand across customers, partners, investors, and the broader industry.
 



  





 You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, partner directly with senior leadership, and have real ownership over strategy and execution from day one. From building executive thought leadership and scaling our content engine to shaping company messaging and sales enablement, your work will have a direct impact on our growth and market presence.
 



  





**WORKING AT COSIGN** 




  





 This is a remote role, with our Marketing team centered around Mexico City. We believe great work happens through both flexibility and connection, so you'll have regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates in person through weekly meetups and team gatherings.
 



  





 Cosign is looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment and is excited to build alongside an ambitious team. We'll give you the autonomy to make an impact, the support to grow, and the opportunity to help shape both our communications function and the future of housing.

title: Senior Couture Pattern Maker & Sample Maker ( freelance )
description:
Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

Pay: AED500\.00 \- AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

 **THE ROLE**

This is not a traditional General Manager role, and it is not a fit for someone whose background is primarily corporate operations, manufacturing, retail, consulting, brand marketing or supply chain.

*Convatec Enterprise – Global \| Full Program Accountability*

**Role Purpose**


The Global General Manager of me\+ is the enterprise leader accountable for the strategy, operating model, consumer experience, and measurable performance of Convatec’ s me\+ program enterprise wide, globally. This is a commercial leadership role, not a brand or marketing management role. Our strategy is earn consumer enrolment and product preference beginning in the acute setting, then deliver ongoing value throughout their journey living with a chronic condition. This leader drives consistent, measurable growth through enrolments, builds the operational backbone that makes the program run at scale, consistently, and ensures me\+ delivers value to healthcare providers so it becomes the widely preferred program in the category. This leader sets the global strategy, program architecture, and performance agenda across the full consumer journey, including me\+ services, websites, digital experiences, ecommerce, and customer call centres. Working through a dedicated team and in partnership with local country teams, the role establishes the people, processes, technology, data, and governance required to scale me\+ consistently while adapting execution to local market needs. This is a Convatec\-wide mandate spanning regions, franchises, and functions. The mission is simple and powerful. Make life more rewarding for people living with a chronic condition.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

* Own the global Convatec me\+ investment plan, program economics, and performance, accountable for growth, cost effectiveness and measurable consumer and business impact.
* Act as general manager for me\+ enterprise\-wide, setting strategy and driving commercial execution across all franchises and regions.
* Deliver consistent, measurable growth in enrolments year over year, focused on winning patients in the acute setting and retaining them across their journey.
* Implement the optimal global program architecture, including the capabilities, processes, technology, data, content, service model and governance required to scale effectively.
* Establish and govern global me\+ standards, KPIs, technology priorities, operating principles and investment decisions while enabling appropriate local market flexibility.
* Develop the integrated consumer acquisition and lifecycle engagement model required to increase qualified enrolment, activation, ongoing engagement and loyalty.
* Lead the end\-to\-end direct\-to\-consumer experience across me\+ services, websites, digital journeys, ecommerce and customer call centres, ensuring a connected, consistent and accessible experience across channels and markets.
* Negotiate and shape future working relationships and commercial terms with third\-party distributors and service providers.
* Lead a matrixed global team to drive speed, scale, consistency, and standardization, advancing markets at every stage of maturity.
* Identify, codify, and share best practices, and build the tools, playbooks, and systems that help countries run the program well.
* Continuously improve the end\-to\-end patient experience and operational effectiveness so me\+ is better at getting and keeping patients.
* Ensure me\+ delivers tangible value to healthcare providers, making it a program clinicians trust, recommend, and prefer.
* Bring curiosity and a bias to action for how AI and digital improve enrolment, engagement, retention, and efficiency.
* Champion responsible use of data, automation and AI to improve personalization, next\-best action, service quality, enrolment, engagement and operating efficiency while protecting consumer trust and privacy.

**Measures of Success:**

* Qualified consumer enrolment and enrolment conversion
* Activation following enrolment.
* Engagement at key points in the care journey
* Retention and continuity within me\+
* Consumer satisfaction, advocacy, and effort
* Healthcare professional awareness, trust, and recommendation
* Awareness and preference for me\+ and Convatec products
* Country adoption of global standards and progression against a maturity model
* Cost per enrolment, cost to serve and program efficiency.
* Demonstrated impact of enrolled consumers through cohort analysis, including product adoption, continuity, reorder behaviour or lifetime engagement where data permits.

**Required Experience**

* Proven commercial leader with a track record of delivering measurable growth, not a brand or product marketing background alone.
* Strong operational depth, including experience building infrastructure, order\-to\-cash processes, and integrating third\-party service partners at scale.
* Demonstrated success negotiating commercial agreements with distributors and third\-party providers.
* Experience leading patient support or consumer\-facing programs, ideally in medtech, medical device, pharma, or healthcare services.
* Experience building consumer acquisition and lifecycle engagement models that deliver measurable improvements in enrolment, activation, retention, and loyalty.
* Experience leading global or enterprise\-wide programs, standardizing and scaling while respecting local market needs, and leading through influence in a matrix.
* Working knowledge of digital and AI tools. Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree in business or related field preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Commercial general manager mindset with clear ownership of results and program growth.
* High sense of urgency, operational rigor, and a strong bias to action.
* Skilled negotiator and partner builder across distributors, service providers, and internal functions.
* Influential enterprise leader who drives alignment across regions, franchises, functions, and cultures.
* Patient\-centred and outcomes\-focused, always tied to making life more rewarding for people living with a chronic condition.

**About Convatec**

  

**Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch:**

  

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company, focused on solutions for the management of chronic conditions, with leading positions in Advanced Wound Care, Ostomy Care, Continence Care, and Infusion Care. With over 10,000 colleagues, we provide products and services in around 90 countries, united by a promise to be forever caring. Your Responsibilities
  
  

About Lockton Northeast
  
For the Northeast Series, you’ll find our people in the metropolitan areas spanning Washington DC, Philadelphia, New York City, Hartford, Norwalk, Boston, and Portland ME. With our unmatched work ethic, and an ability to go above and beyond to make a difference for our clients, the Northeast continues to experience double\-digit (organic!) growth.
  
  

We offer a flexible \& hybrid work environment that allows our Associates to split their time between in\-person and remote.
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Account Executive is a critical role in the Northeast Series. The role is focused on managing a portfolio of high\-profile Clients within the Lockton Northeast Series Middle Market platform. The Account Executive is the primary contact for the Client and is responsible for leading the overall Client relationship. This Associate will be directly responsible for the program design, negotiation, and placement of select Property \& Casualty coverage lines as well as overall day\-to\-day servicing. They will also work directly with the various Units/Practices within Lockton to manage lines of coverage not placed by the Account Executive. The Account Executive will also be responsible for full alignment between the Client’s business objectives/strategy and the technical expertise brought by the Lockton team. The Account Executive also ensures that Lockton resources are deployed efficiently to meet the Client’s needs. A high performing and successful Account Executive will be a strategic leader, give great advice, help grow our business, deliver transactional excellence, and provide great customer service.
  
  

Core Responsibilities
  
  

Leads Lockton team, establishes client strategy and oversees service delivery across all practices
  
Maintains strong relationships with key Client contacts and works with Producer (where applicable) to coordinate senior\-level Client communications
  
Provides visible leadership, both internally and externally
  
Offers expert coverage and risk management advice to assigned Clients
  
Works closely with Client to plan and develop annual renewal strategy
  
Listens to Client concerns, provides meaningful advice and develops potential solutions
  
Initiates/leads renewal efforts, including market negotiations
  
Leverages analytics to develop risk strategies, support renewal negotiations and help Clients make informed decisions
  
Manages the performance of the entire Client service team, ensuring superior outcomes for our clients
  
Broad knowledge of Client’s business, industry and risks, including financial, operational and strategic goals/planning
  
Deep understanding of Clients’ entire insurance and risk management programs
  
Uses understanding of Client’s business and financial profile to help Clients and the Lockton team build long\-term risk strategy
  
Manages efficient communication with Client and serves as single point\-of\-contact (as needed – or when requested)
  
Responsible for best\-in\-class client deliverables aligned with Lockton Northeast Client Engagement strategy (RSM, Renewal Proposals, Stewardship Docs, etc.)
  
Stays abreast of industry trends and changes in governmental regulations
  
Builds and maintains senior level carrier relationships, including developing new markets, necessary to drive outcomes or solve problems
  
Works with Producers to develop strategy, identify/align internal resources and support new business opportunities
  
  

Mentors and develops junior Associates and is vested in their development
  
  

**A successful candidate will have:**  

An eagerness and enthusiasm to be an integral part of their respective Unit or Practice
  
Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills to communicate effectively and professionally to all levels
  
An ability to manage a complex and demanding Client portfolio. Candidate must excel at multi\-tasking, adapting to change and working on tight deadlines to meet our Clients’ needs
  
An ability to manage time, prioritize and ensure that deadlines are met without compromising quality
  
A thorough understanding of Lockton Northeast processes and protocols which align with the overall Client Engagement strategy
  
The intellectual curiosity and quantitative mindset to leverage analytics to inform strategy, support negotiation and assist our clients in making decisions
  
A broad understanding of the insurance marketplace including an ability to develop and execute on agreed Client marketing / placement strategies
  
Well developed, respected senior\-level insurer relationships
  
An ability to lead the Lockton Client service team ensuring consistent execution aligned with developed overall strategies
  
The desire to mentor and develop junior Associates, including Interns, Analysts, Senior Analysts and Client Managers
  
  

Qualifications
  
Bachelor's degree in a business\-related program preferred or equivalent education and/or experience required
  
A minimum of five years of commercial Property and Casualty insurance experience and / or insurance broking / consulting experience required
  
Understanding of insurance/risk management concepts and their application to Clients' needs
  
Ability to analyze and interpret financial information to facilitate decision making and develop an understanding of the financial condition of Clients and prospects
  
Must have exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal skills to instill confidence in Clients and Associates at all levels of responsibility
  
Must have the ability to lead a client service team
  
Maintains a network of key insurer relationships
  
Superior negotiation skills
  
Ability to comply with all company policies and procedures, proactively protecting confidentiality of client and company information
  
Willingness and ability to work outside of normal business hours and travel as needed
  
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for this position, now or in the future
  
Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  

Lockton Companies is proud to provide everyone an equal opportunity to grow and advance. We are committed to an inclusive culture and environment where our people, clients and communities are treated with respect and dignity.
  
  

At Lockton, supporting diversity, equity and inclusion is ingrained in our values, and we believe that we are at our best when we fully embrace everyone. We strive to cultivate a caring culture that learns from, celebrates and thrives because of our breadth of differences. As such, we recognize that recruiting, developing and retaining people with diverse backgrounds and experiences is vital and enabling our people to thrive personally and professionally is critical to our long\-term success.

**Making an impact:** An...
  
Fundación Cuenta Conmigo is a nonprofit foundation created to support low\-income families with a family member suffering from cancer in the Chilean public health system. Specifically, the foundation assists families navigating the process of their child’s cancer treatment. This includes covering expenses and helping address needs that are not supported by the State or other non\-governmental institutions. This organization is near and dear to Ana Wainer’s heart. Her son, Dante’s, close friend, Vicente, was diagnosed with pre\-leukemia at age 9\. After long and exhausting treatment, he underwent a bone marrow transplant. Unfortunately, it was not successful. Vicente later relapsed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia, "a diagnosis that profoundly changed the lives of his family and of all of us who knew him and accompanied them throughout the process,” Ana says. At age 11, after a long and courageous battle, Vincente passed away. “Despite the deep sorrow, Vicente left us invaluable life lessons and opened our eyes to a reality that often remains invisible to much of society,” Ana says. Shortly after his passing in March 2019, Vicente’s parents founded Fundación Cuenta Conmigo in 2020\. Ana was a co\-founder of the foundation and served as a volunteer member on the board of directors for three years. Through her role at Lockton, she coordinated activities between Lockton and the foundation as part of their Christmas initiatives since 2022\. “From the moment I introduced the foundation at Lockton, the company was very open to collaborating and the response was overwhelmingly positive,” Ana says. “When I invited my colleagues to participate as volunteers, everyone showed a genuine interest in helping in any way needed.” Ana’s love and dedication towards this foundation have been recognized by Lockton, earning her the Lockton Cares Community Impact Award for the Latin America region. This award celebrates Lockton Associates across the globe who go above and beyond to improve their communities through volunteering and philanthropy. Each recipient can direct a $25,000 donation to a charity of their choice, funded directly by the Lockton family. “As first I was genuinely surprised to hear my name, followed by a deep sense of emotion, pride, and gratitude,” Ana explains. The award funds were used to purchase a brand\-new utility vehicle, which is now used to distribute the various donations the foundation receives and delivers to families undergoing treatment in public hospitals. Donations include food, Christmas gifts, medical supplies, orthopedic equipment, and other essential items as needs arise. Ana had to step down from her role on the board of directors, but this award represents the support she wished she could have continued providing. “I feel like it is a kind of legacy that Lockton helped me leave for the foundation, for Vicente, and for his family,” she says. As she becomes more familiar with Lockton culture, Ana says it was a pleasant surprise to see that the importance of culture is not something just written on paper, but something truly reflected in the company’s commitment to charitable causes around the world. “Lockton genuinely cares,” Ana says. It’s no secret how much this foundation means to Ana, and she will continue contributing and encourage more people show support in any way they can. Fundación Cuenta Conmiga gave Ana an opportunity to discover an unfamiliar world—one that anyone could find themselves in one day. “It taught me to value what I have,” she says. “To be more empathetic toward those going through difficult times."

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!
   

  

****Plus those special extra things.****
 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

All employment decisions will be made, and all qualified applicants will be considered, without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or other legally protected characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, MeUndies will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.**

**Director of Brand Marketing**

 Four days in office, one day remote
 



  





**About Electric Picks** 




  





 Electric Picks is a rapidly growing jewelry brand known for trend\-forward styles, meaningful storytelling, and a lifetime guarantee. We’re entering an exciting new chapter and looking for a Director of Brand Marketing who can help define what the brand becomes next.

 The Director of Brand Marketing, will lead how Electric Picks shows up in the world.

 This is a unique opportunity for someone who is looking build the next big lifestyle brand. If you have strong ideas, commercial instincts, and the ability to turn vision into action this role is for you.

**Shape the Brand** 




  




* Partner with the Head of Marketing and Senior Art Director to define and evolve the Electric Picks brand strategy.
* Translate company priorities into integrated marketing plans that build awareness, attract new customers, and drive revenue.
* Identify opportunities to increase cultural relevance through positioning, storytelling, partnerships, activations, and community.
* Bring consumer insights, cultural trends, and competitive intelligence into the brand’s decision\-making.
* Champion bold, thoughtful ideas that deepen the relationship between Electric Picks and its customers.

* Lead integrated campaign planning across eCommerce, Social, CRM, PR, Wholesale, and Paid Media.

**Create Cultural Moments** 




  




* Lead experiential events, community activations, influencer trips, OOH, partnerships, and other real\-world brand experiences.

* Build a strategic pipeline of UGC and commissioned content that supports both organic storytelling and paid acquisition.
* Find new ways for Electric Picks to participate in culture and connect meaningfully with its community.

* Manage, mentor, and develop members of the Brand Marketing and Social teams.
* Shape the brand’s social presence so that every touchpoint reflects a consistent voice, point of view, and personality.
* Serve as the central marketing partner across Creative, Growth, eCommerce, PR, Product, and Wholesale.
* Establish clear priorities, ownership, and expectations across the team.
* Build scalable workflows and planning tools that improve clarity, accountability, and execution.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, high standards, and strong follow\-through.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




  




* 6\+ years of brand marketing experience, ideally within fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, or another consumer\-led category.

* Strong instincts for storytelling, culture, partnerships, events, community, and consumer behavior.
* Experience translating business priorities into cohesive omnichannel marketing plans.
* The ability to move comfortably between strategy, creative development, planning, and hands\-on execution.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with Creative, Growth, Digital, PR, Product, and Commercial teams.
* Experience managing and developing high\-performing team members.
* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Commercial fluency and the ability to balance creative ambition with budgets, timelines, and measurable results.



  





**You’ll Thrive Here If You Are** 




  




* A brand builder who is excited by the opportunity to help define the next chapter of a growing company.
* A strategic operator who can see the big picture and translate it into a clear, actionable plan.
* A creative thinker with strong taste, cultural curiosity, and a distinct point of view.
* A hands\-on leader who is willing to jump into the work and help move it forward.
* A natural owner who identifies opportunities, solves problems, and creates momentum.
* A clear and thoughtful communicator who brings people together around a shared vision.
* A low\-ego, high\-EQ collaborator who knows when to lead, support, and execute.
* A mentor who raises the quality of thinking and execution across the team.



  





**Why Electric Picks** 




  





 You’ll join Electric Picks at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to influence the brand’s long\-term vision while making an immediate impact. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, lead high\-visibility initiatives, and help build the campaigns, experiences, team, and operating foundation that support our next stage of growth.
